item.title: Committee for Children: Senior Product Manager - Edtech Innovation
item.description:
Headquarters: 2815 2nd Ave, Seattle, WA 98121, USA
URL: https://www.cfchildren.org/

Are you looking for purpose-driven work where you can make a positive impact on communities around the world? If so, then Committee for Children is an amazing place to grow your career as a Senior Product Manager of Edtech Innovation. We’re a social enterprise dedicated to advancing the well-being of children through the development of essential human skills. As a Senior Product Manager, Edtech Innovation at CFC, you'll lead the development of a new product line for the K–12 U.S. education market, driving strategy and execution from concept to launch. The role focuses on translating market insights into innovative, scalable solutions that support students, educators, and schools, and on running disciplined agile delivery to turn that strategy into shipped, validated product. Working closely with the VP, Product, leadership, and cross-functional teams, the position guides innovation, secures resources, and manages performance to ensure products are impactful and sustainable.

What you’ll do when you join us:

Product Strategy & Vision

  • Collaborate with the VP, Product and other members of the leadership team in the development of portfolio-expanding new products aligned with our diversification strategy and organizational mission
  • Translate student, educator, and district needs into a compelling, scalable product vision
  • Define success metrics and establish product goals grounded in user value, learning outcomes, and business impact
  • Own the product roadmap and backlog prioritization, and hold final accountability for stage-gate go/no-go decisions

Portfolio Governance & Board Reporting

  • Represent the product and team at quarterly Impact Committee (Board of Directors) meetings and at key project milestones, presenting business cases, evidence, and progress to build board confidence and credibility in the product line; bring core team members into these sessions when it strengthens that case
  • Participate in monthly Bridge Role meetings with department directors—the connective tissue between the product team and cross-departmental leadership—presenting roadmap, business case, and evidence updates, and partnering on planning for the product’s ongoing support and growth beyond launch

Market Research & Concept Development

  • Conduct ongoing market research to identify trends, gaps, and opportunities in the education sector.
  • Collaborate with educators, administrators, and technology partners to ensure product relevance and feasibility.
  • Generate, refine, and prioritize innovative product ideas that align with impact and revenue goals.

0–1 Product Development

  • Lead the design and development of product prototypes that bring early concepts to life and enable rapid iteration.
  • Design and execute testing strategies to gather user feedback, validate assumptions, and refine product concepts and prototypes.
  • Lead roadmap creation and iterative development from concept to launch
  • Build business cases and secure executive buy-in and resources

Execution & Agile Delivery

  • Own and continuously refine the product backlog in the team’s tools of record (e.g., Jira, Confluence), writing clear epics, stories, and acceptance criteria that translate strategy into sprint-ready work
  • Facilitate agile ceremonies—sprint planning, backlog refinement, and retrospectives—and maintain a consistent sprint cadence in partnership with delivery/project management
  • Track delivery health (velocity, cycle time) and drive iterative, evidence-based delivery: ship in small increments and adjust scope based on real user feedback and data

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Collaborate with researchers, instructional designers, UX, engineering, and go-to-market teams, with clear ownership across the team
  • Facilitate agile rituals and ensure alignment across product, design, and technical execution
  • Manage timelines, dependencies, and deliverables to ensure high-quality outcomes

Operational & Financial Oversight

  • Manage the budget for product innovation, ensuring efficient and strategic use of resources.
  • Monitor product performance and iterate based on user feedback, learning outcomes, and business impact.

Here’s what we’re looking for:

  • 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in EdTech or youth-focused industries
  • Proven track record leading 0–1 product development and launching new products that achieved scale and revenue targets
  • Demonstrated experience using AI tools for product development, user research, or personalization
  • Hands-on experience with agile/Scrum or Kanban practices and tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence) for backlog management, sprint planning, and delivery tracking
  • Experience managing or influencing cross-functional teams
  • Deep understanding of K–12 education markets, especially district and school purchasing dynamics
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills
  • Travel Requirements: Travel is typically quarterly but may be as frequent as every two months for research, testing, and other activities as needed.
  • Note: This position is remote; employees are eligible to work remotely in any of the following states: AZ, CA, CO, CT, FL, GA, IL, MA, NJ, NM, NY, OH, OR, PA, TX, VA, WA.

The hiring range for this position is $133,000-165,000 annually. The pay offered will take into account internal equity and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience, among other factors.

What we offer

Our benefits, perks, and rewards are aimed at helping you live your best life at CFC.

  • We cover 100% of your premiums for medical, dental and vision coverage and 50% for your dependent’s medical and dental premiums
  • Retirement plan + company match up to 3%; CFC
  • A flexible work subsidy: $100 per month that you can use on things like phone and internet costs, office supplies, or even commuting costs
  • 16 paid holidays (including winter break and 1 floating holiday), 3 weeks' vacation in your first year, and separate sick leave accrual
  • Other great benefits include: monthly contribution to childcare and/or dependent expenses, FSA account, parental leave, sabbatical leave, employee assistance program, annual wellness reimbursement, growth and development opportunities, disability and life insurance.

 

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/committee-for-children-senior-product-manager-edtech-innovation

item.title: Aquifer: Development Manager
item.skills: Ruby on Rails, SaaS, and Jira
item.description:
Headquarters: New Hampshire
URL: https://aquifer.org/

Summary

The Development Manager reports into the Chief Technology Officer and owns the engineering capacity, delivery commitments, and technical execution quality across Aquifer's development pods. Directly manages all engineers, including the pod tech leads and a technical architect, with full people-management responsibility. The Development Manager owns release reliability and the delivery/quality dimensions of engineering performance. 

Responsibilities:

  • Ensure engineering executes the cadence necessary to deliver on roadmap commitments set by the Lead Product Manager.

  • Own engineering scorecard metrics for quality and delivery.

  • Directly manage all engineers, including both pod tech leads: performance, career development, hiring, day-to-day support.

  • Provide meaningful roles and assignments for engineers through talent and capability mapping.

  • Own engineering capacity planning, translating roadmap commitments into realistic delivery plans.

  • Own release reliability and production quality across both pods.

  • Participate in engineering planning at every cadence.

  • Lead the effort with the Technical Architect to adopt AI development best practices to increase velocity and quality. 

  • Support and grow the existing Rails-based product with attention to technical sustainability and delivery cost.

  • Partner with the Lead Product Manager and both tech leads on cross-functional delivery planning.

Qualifications

  • Proven experience managing engineering teams, engineering managers, or senior individual contributors — ideally in a Ruby on Rails environment.

  • Track record of owning delivery commitments and release quality for a live SaaS product.

  • Experience managing distributed or multi-site engineering teams.

  • Demonstrated ability to evaluate the technical judgment and output of senior or staff-level engineers.

  • Comfortable setting and enforcing technical and process guardrails for AI-assisted software development.

  • Experience running structured capability assessments (e.g., evaluating a technical architect against defined deliverables) is a plus.

  • Working familiarity with Jira/Confluence.

 

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/aquifer-development-manager

item.title: OnTheGoSystems: Head of Content and Editorial
item.skills: AI Content Creation, SEO, Editing, and AI Agents
item.description:
Headquarters: Remote
URL: http://onthegosystems.com

At OnTheGoSystems, the company behind WPML, Toolset, and PTC, we’re looking for an experienced Head of Content and Editorial who knows what makes content great and can take ownership of content quality and performance.

AI is a core part of how we work. AI can already produce content quickly and efficiently. What we need is someone with the experience, strong editorial judgment, and intuition to turn AI-generated content into high-quality, valuable content that resonates with our readers and delivers real business results.

We’re looking for someone who has experience working with a small team of skilled writers, setting high editorial standards, and making content successful. You should know what good writing looks like, understand why certain content works, and be able to improve it.

What You’ll Work On

  • Content strategy and editorial direction – identify what content we should create, for whom, and why.

  • Content quality and editing – review, improve, and refine content to make it clear, engaging, accurate, and valuable.

  • AI-assisted content creation – use AI tools and workflows to produce high-quality content efficiently while maintaining strong editorial standards.

  • Content performance – track results, understand what makes content successful, and use data to improve it.

  • Content experiments – test new ideas, formats, and approaches, learn from failures, and build on what works.

  • Collaboration with marketing and product teams – understand our products, customers, and business goals to make sure our content supports them.

What We’re Looking For

  • You’ve managed small teams of skilled writers and know how to improve and maintain high content quality.

  • You have excellent editing and copywriting skills. You can easily spot what works in content and what needs improvement.

  • You know how to use AI effectively to create and edit content.

  • You’re comfortable working with metrics and taking responsibility for content performance. You use data to understand what works and what doesn't.

  • You have strong editorial intuition built through years of experience. You’re comfortable trying new ideas, making decisions, and checking the results.

  • You’re curious and want to understand our products, customers, and business.

  • You’re hands-on and independent. You can take ownership of your work without detailed instructions.

  • You have experience with technology, software, SaaS, or technical content.

We are especially interested in people who have spent years working in high-quality editorial environments, where great writing, strong editorial judgment, and measurable results are essential.

We’re not looking for someone whose main experience is managing large volumes of low-quality content. We want someone who knows how to make good content exceptional.

Why Join Us

OnTheGoSystems is a profitable, self-funded product company growing since 2007. WPML powers more than 1.5 million websites worldwide.

You’ll have real ownership of our editorial direction, work closely with our CEO, marketing, and product teams, and help shape how we create high-quality content with AI.

You’ll have the freedom to experiment, make decisions, and see the impact of your work through real results.

We care about the people we work with and want to support them beyond their day-to-day work. Along with the flexibility of working remotely, we offer perks and benefits that support both work and life.

If you have years of editorial experience, love great writing, and are excited about shaping the future of content with AI, we’d love to hear from you.

 

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/onthegosystems-head-of-content-and-editorial

item.title: Storyblok: Salesforce Lead - USA
item.description:
Headquarters: Remote

Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond.

Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact.

 

WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU

You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits:

  • Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…)
  • Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding
  • Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays
  • Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material
  • The annual international team-building trip, quarterly and monthly online get-togethers
  • As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you’ll enjoy flexible schedules
  • An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals

JOB SUMMARY

Storyblok is hiring a Salesforce Lead to own Salesforce architecture, execution, governance, data quality, integrations, and release discipline across our GTM workflows. This techno-functional owner moves from business process to system design, build coordination, release control, data quality, reporting impact, and user adoption, owning Sales Cloud and core CRM objects, Pardot / Account Engagement, DealHub CPQ integration, lead-to-cash and quote-to-cash workflows, routing, campaign and lifecycle data, permissions, integrations, and documentation. The role also leads future platform evaluation for Salesforce Data 360, Salesforce Marketing Cloud Advanced, Adobe Marketing Cloud, Oracle Responsys, and related CDP needs, and, if a platform is selected, leads implementation planning and execution with RevOps, Marketing Operations, Data, Finance, Legal, vendors, and external partners.

 ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

  1. Salesforce architecture and GTM systems governance
  • Own Salesforce platform architecture across GTM workflows, objects, fields, permissions, automations, integrations, and release control.
  • Translate RevOps, Marketing Operations, Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and Data requirements into clean system design and controlled execution.
  • Maintain governance for new fields, objects, flows, validation rules, permission sets, integrations, reporting dependencies, and documentation.
  1. Sales Cloud and core CRM ownership
  • Own system design for leads, contacts, accounts, opportunities, activities, campaigns, lifecycle stages, routing, renewals, expansions, and customer handoffs.
  • Support lead-to-cash workflows with clear ownership, required fields, source logic, stage rules, assignment logic, and adoption checks.
  • Monitor CRM completeness, data freshness, duplicates, routing failures, and workflow friction that creates manual workarounds.
  1. Pardot, Account Engagement, and marketing workflow support
  • Partner with Marketing Operations on Pardot or Account Engagement, campaign data, lifecycle stages, scoring inputs, consent, routing, attribution support, and funnel reporting.
  • Maintain the Salesforce-side architecture for marketing-to-sales handoffs, campaign member data, source fields, conversion logic, and reporting quality.
  • Keep current marketing workflows stable while future marketing cloud and CDP options are evaluated.
  1. Future Data 360, SFMC Advanced, Adobe, Oracle, and CDP evaluation
  • Lead the requirements, scorecard, architecture review, vendor comparison, data governance review, and implementation readiness plan for future customer data and marketing cloud decisions.
  • Evaluate Salesforce Data 360, Salesforce Marketing Cloud Advanced, Adobe Marketing Cloud, Oracle Responsys, and related CDP needs against GTM use cases, data model, activation, consent, reporting, integration, cost, and operating complexity.
  • If a platform is selected, lead implementation planning and execution with clear phases, owners, risks, testing, migration, enablement, and adoption metrics.
  1. DealHub CPQ integration, data quality, releases, and adoption
  • Own Salesforce-side integration quality for DealHub CPQ, including quote data, approval sync, product lines, opportunity fields, order handoffs, and reporting impact.
  • Run release management with intake, solution design, testing, regression checks, deployment, communication, documentation, and adoption tracking.
  • Partner with Data on source-to-report logic so Salesforce, warehouse, Finance, and leadership reporting stay aligned.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 6+ years in the Salesforce ecosystem, including hands-on administration and solution / architecture ownership in a GTM or Revenue Operations context.
  • Salesforce certifications strongly preferred (e.g., Administrator, Advanced Administrator, Platform App Builder; Sales Cloud Consultant or Application Architect a plus).
  • Hands-on experience with Sales Cloud, core CRM objects, declarative automation (Flow), permissions, and release / change management across environments.
  • Experience with Pardot / Marketing Cloud Account Engagement and marketing-to-sales workflows, and with CPQ tools (DealHub or comparable) across lead-to-cash and quote-to-cash.
  • Experience integrating Salesforce with downstream systems (data warehouse, Finance, marketing, order management) and supporting reporting and data quality.
  • Familiarity with CDP / marketing cloud platform evaluation (e.g., Salesforce Data 360, SFMC Advanced, Adobe, Oracle Responsys) is a plus.
  • Demonstrates AI literacy, with the ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making, and quality of work while applying sound judgment and critical thinking.

PROFESSIONAL COMPETENCIES

  • Systems thinking: translates cross-functional business requirements into clean, scalable system design and governance.
  • Technical CRM depth: strong command of Salesforce architecture, data model, automation, permissions, and integrations.
  • Release and change discipline: structured intake, testing, regression, deployment, documentation, and adoption tracking.
  • Data quality and governance orientation: drives completeness, freshness, deduplication, and field control.
  • Stakeholder management: partners effectively across RevOps, Marketing Operations, Sales, CS, Finance, Data, Legal, and vendors.
  • Vendor and platform evaluation: builds requirements, scorecards, and implementation readiness plans for major platform decisions.
  • Clear communication: explains what is being built, the decision needed, and the business outcome to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Bias for reliability: reduces defects, manual workarounds, and ambiguity through documentation and controlled execution.

 

U.S. Base Salary Range: $102,900 - $140,000

At Storyblok, we are committed to equitable compensation and pay transparency. We consider many factors when it comes to compensation, such as the scope of the role, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Our base salary ranges are determined by job and job level and are benchmarked to relevant location and industry data. The range displayed represents the target US base compensation range within which we are hiring for this role. For some roles Storyblok also offers a competitive commission structure.

 

 

 

 

 

MENTAL, PHYSICAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL REQUIREMENTS

Remote (home) work opportunity or funded by Storyblok co-working space

GENERAL TERMS

Storyblok has a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We strive to create a hiring environment in which all people feel they are equally respected and valued, irrespective of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, religion, citizenship or any other characteristic. You can find more information about our privacy policy here.

All communications regarding job opportunities at Storyblok will come from an official Storyblok employee with an email address ending in @storyblok.com. We will never redirect you to another portal or another site that is unrelated to our domain (storyblok.com).

Here is a sneak peek of Storyblok’s Visual Editor

If you need an accommodation for any part of the application process, please email talent.acquisition@storyblok.com

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/storyblok-salesforce-lead-usa

item.title: Ping Identity: Channel Account Manager
item.description:
Headquarters: AUS-Remote

About Ping Identity: 

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it. 

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear. 

While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work. 

We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management. 

The Channel Account Manager (CAM) at Ping Identity plays a vital role in supporting the growth and success of the company's channel and alliances GTM. This role involves collaborating with the Partner ecosystem to develop and manage partnerships, help drive joint business development initiatives, and ensure effective communication and coordination with our channel partners.

The CAM will contribute to the expansion of Ping Identity's market reach and the achievement of revenue goals.

  • Reporting into the VP of Partnerships APJ, you will manage and support target partners across all Partner tiers helping to manage our partners across Australia and New Zealand.
  • Work closely with the sales team across Australia and New Zealand to support their regional GTM requirements
    • Important - You will ensure the Ping sales team are able to focus on finding, qualifying and closing opportunities with our partners - you act as the conduit between our sales team and our partners
  • Support and drive the development of joint value propositions with our partners.
  • Collaborate with partners to execute partner agreements and ensure other agreements are in place as required.
  • Assist in driving partner enablement, including the development of sales practices and training programs.
  • Help partners with deal registrations, portal access, program benefits etc.
  • Contribute to tracking partner performance against agreed-upon metrics, such as revenue targets and pipeline development.
  • Foster collaborative relationships with partners through ongoing engagement, communication, and business reviews.
  • Support the execution of marketing and demand generation activities with partners to drive brand awareness and lead generation.
  • Support the promotion and engagement with the Ping Partner program and related tools and processes.
  • Assist in coordinating and participating in joint business planning activities with partners.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure effective communication and coordination with partners.
  • Assist in ensuring partner success by monitoring delivery quality, customer satisfaction, and support.
  • Contribute to joint pursuits with partners, identifying and developing sales opportunities and impacting existing opportunities to close with the influence of Partners.
  • Stay updated on industry trends, market dynamics, and competitor activities to identify new business opportunities and challenges

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • This role is based in Sydney or Melbourne.
    • Important - This role requires regular collaboration with Ping colleagues and partners, typically including multiple in-person meetings each week.
    • Additional partner or customer meetings may be required as the business needs dictate.
  • You have 3+ year’s experience managing partners and exposure to GSI & Advisory Partners would be a bonus. Alternatively, you have excelled in a Partner BDR/SDR function and are looking to move up in your career.
  • You have a good understanding of the Australia and New Zealand market.
  • You are currently working in the SaaS industry, but working in Cyber Security and SaaSwill move you right to the top of the list.
  • Understanding of channel sales strategies and partner ecosystems.
  • Ability to drive mutual business outcomes for both Ping and our Partners - this includes regular cadence, partner QBRs etc.
  • Good CRM opportunity hygiene (Salesforce preferred).
  • Strong organisational and coordination skills and the ability to work cross functionally with presales, marketing, professional services, customer success etc.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Willingness to learn and adapt to changing priorities and responsibilities.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to travel domestically as required and 1-2 international trips per year (US).
  • …and have fun and enjoy the ride working in a very high growth dynamic environment for a great company headquartered in Denver Colorado

Other:

  • Familiarity with Salesforce.com or other CRM systems.
  • Previous experience or exposure to channel sales, alliances management, or partner enablement is a must.
  • Interest in the software industry and identity access management sector.
  • Knowledge of marketing and demand generation practices.
  • Understanding of partner training and sales enablement processes.
  • Ability to analyse data and generate insights to drive partner performance.
  • Proactive and positive mindset with a focus on continuous improvement.

Life at Ping:

We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We’re growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that’s who we want to succeed with every day. 

Here are just a few of the things that make Ping special:

  • A company culture that empowers you to do your best work.
  • Employee Resource Groups that create a sense of belonging for everyone.
  • Regular company and team bonding events.
  • Competitive benefits and perks.
  • Global volunteering and community initiatives

Our Benefits: 

  • Generous PTO & Holiday Schedule 
  • Parental Leave
  • Progressive Healthcare Options
  • Retirement Programs
  • Opportunity for Education Reimbursement 
  • Commuter Offset (Specific locations) 

Ping is the collective sum of all our individual experiences, backgrounds and influences and we pride ourselves in growing and learning together. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse environment where everyone’s individuality is respected and everyone has an Identity. In recruiting for new colleagues, we welcome the unique contributions you can bring and encourage you to be your best self.

We are an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/ping-identity-channel-account-manager-1

item.title: Checkr: Strategic Account Executive
item.description:
Headquarters: Remote, United States; San Francisco, California, United States

About Checkr
Checkr is building the data platform to power safe and fair decisions. Over 140,000 companies and millions of people rely on Checkr for AI verification in the moments that matter most: getting a new job, a new place to live, a car ride, childcare, even a date. Customers include Uber, Pennymac, Airbnb, Doordash, and Anthropic.

We’re a team that thrives on solving complex problems with innovative solutions that advance our mission. Checkr is recognized on Forbes Cloud 100 2025 List and is a Y Combinator 2024 Breakthrough Company.

About the Role

Truework, recently acquired by Checkr, provides access to crucial employment, income information and asset information needed for mortgage loans, apartment rentals, background checks, and more. We are disrupting a $5B+ industry, dominated by legacy incumbents and outdated processes, with a better product and intense customer focus. Within Checkr, Truework operates independently, allowing rapid iteration while also being able to leverage the strengths and assets from our core business. Think of it like joining a startup within a startup!

As a Strategic Account Executive on the Truework team, you’ll help scale our impact across large national and regional lenders, with a primary focus on acquiring new clients to Truework Verification services. As automated verification services become a more common practice for lenders in how they run their operation, you’ll lead the charge in building and executing a more repeatable playbook to drive new customers who will grow with us for years to come. By deeply understanding their unique company challenges and goals, you will pair them with solutions that will help them reach their business objectives and innovate within their organizations. 

This role is ideal for a proven sales professional who:

  • has experience selling transformational solutions to customers, where you can quickly identify and pattern map where and how the Truework solution can drive impact in a customer’s operation
  • has experience identifying and building relationships with decision makers, business and technology influencers and users, closing 6- and 7-figure pursuits
  • who thrives in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment— ready to help close the gap between the legacy solutions and processes lending teams are leaning on and their plans and intentions to deliver competitive and streamlined processes for consumers 

You will be an important part of an elite, professional, and rapidly growing cross-functional team that succeeds through collaboration, grit, and learning.

What you’ll do

  • Deliver Sales Excellence:
    • Consistently achieve pipeline and revenue targets by applying modern sales techniques and processes to efficiently manage top of funnel engagement tactics and deal strategy and close processes
    • Think outside-the-box to cultivate awareness of the Truework vision. Plan and execute targeted campaigns for your territory working with the marketing and partner teams to scale your coverage and build pipeline 
    • Partner with and guide the efforts of our internal team to support your accounts in pre-sales activities and in the deployment to execute on agreed upon account goals, strategies and tactics for growth
    • Leverage analytics, case studies, past performance, and market intelligence to create a territory plan and craft your own target account strategies.
  • Manage Account Relationships:
    • Have an understanding of the lender’s operation and an ability to identify the varying use cases where verification services can drive impact 
    • Exhibit deep and up-to-date knowledge of our product portfolio in order to communicate the benefits of new features and enhancements
    • Show proficiency in navigating buy team personas, with intentional activities for executive bridging and champion building
  • Exhibit Industry- & Customer-specific Business Acumen:
    • Actively understand each customer’s strategic growth plans, technology footprint, and corresponding technology strategy, internal challenges, and competitive landscape.
    • Review public information (e.g., new executive appointments, earnings statements, press releases) for the company and its competitors to stay updated on key industry trends and issues impacting the prospect. 
    • Be equipped to identify and discover centers of value for lenders, and conduct analysis to quantify ROI and impact of our solution on their operation
  • Be a good teammate
    • Represent both market trends and client needs to the Executive and the Product teams to ensure we are both serving current needs well and evolving our products and portfolio to identify future client needs 
    • Show unparalleled grit - constantly experiment, be willing to pivot, and have resiliency regardless of the obstacles faced

What you bring

  • 5+ years of full-cycle sales experience, selling transformative technology solutions 
  • Experience closing new business accounts and building pipeline using modern marketing tactics
  • Experience selling to EVPs, CXOs and end-users (in the same sales cycle) in both individual and team sales environments
  • Ability to navigate large organizations’ political landscape to maintain and expand relationships at all levels
  • General knowledge in common sales practices like MEDDPICC, Command of the Message (Force Management), Challenger, Power Selling, or others
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills - able to simplify complex topics in a friendly and approachable manner, present executive-level business cases 
  • Ability to juggle and complete multiple priorities and projects (internally and externally) in a fast-paced environment
  • You are smart, self-motivated, organized, disciplined, inquisitive, detail-oriented, and process-oriented; you have an ownership mentality within all aspects of your work
  • You have a growth mindset that is always learning, growing, and actively seeking feedback
  • You have a team-first mentality—you show up for your team and expect the same in return. You enjoy planning, adjusting, executing, winning, and celebrating as a team.
  • An A-player mindset with a strong bias for action: you raise the bar, move with urgency, stay resilient through ambiguity, and take ownership to deliver meaningful outcomes.

Pay Transparency Disclosure

We use geographic cost of labor as an input to develop ranges for our roles and as such, each location where we hire may have a different range. If this role is remote, we have listed the top to the bottom of the possible range, but we will specify the target range for an exact location when you are selected for a recruiting discussion. For more information on our compensation philosophy, see our website.

On-target Earnings OR Base Salary range (San Francisco, CA)
$298,642—$351,343 USD

Pay Transparency Disclosure

One of Checkr’s core values is Transparency. To live by that value, we’ve made the decision to disclose salary ranges in all of our job postings. We use geographic cost of labor as an input to develop ranges for our roles and as such, each location where we hire may have a different range. If this role is remote, we have listed the top to the bottom of the possible range, but we will specify the target range for an exact location when you are selected for a recruiting discussion. For more information on our compensation philosophy, see our website.

On-target Earnings OR Base Salary range (Remote)
$229,724—$351,343 USD

What We Offer

  • A fast-paced and collaborative environment
  • Learning and development allowance
  • Competitive cash and equity compensation, and opportunity for advancement
  • 100% medical, dental, and vision coverage

item.title: Discord: QA/DevOps Engineer
item.description:
Headquarters: San Francisco Bay Area or Remote (U.S.)

Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

We are seeking a QA/DevOps Engineer to join Discord’s Business Systems team. In this role, you will own automated test suite development and maintenance across Oracle ERP Cloud (Fusion) and Salesforce, with a focus on Tosca-based regression and progression testing. You will embed automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and partner closely with ERP Functional, Technical, and DevOps teams to ensure every release is tested consistently and defects are caught early.

What you'll be doing

  • Run Oracle ERP Cloud and Salesforce QA automation suites for all quarterly patch upgrades end-to-end.
  • Review new Oracle and SFDC release features and recommend improvements to existing testing processes.
  • Build and improve regression and progression test automation in the Tosca environment for Oracle Fusion and Salesforce.
  • Create, maintain, and update Tosca scripts to reflect system and process changes across GL, AP, AR, and FAH modules.
  • Lead feature enhancement reviews as part of quarterly patch assessment cycles and new enhancement projects.
  • Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines; trigger regression suites automatically on every release candidate build.
  • Maintain test infrastructure and environments in collaboration with DevOps and ERP Technical teams.
  • Document test coverage, defect trends, and release readiness in Jira and shared reporting dashboards.

Automation Use Cases

  • FAH Process Automation: Auto-test Financial Accounting Hub on each new sales item addition to eliminate manual unit testing.
  • AR Regression Suite: Automated flows for invoicing, receipts, and customer setup across every release.
  • AP Regression Suite: Payment runs, supplier invoices, holds, and approvals tested automatically on each patch cycle.
  • Salesforce Tosca Automation: Develop, maintain, and expand automated SFDC test suites in Tosca, integrated with release pipelines.

What you should have

  • 3-5+ years of QA automation experience.
  • Hands-on Tosca experience for regression and progression test suite development and maintenance.
  • Experience executing and maintaining automated test cycles for quarterly Oracle patch upgrades.
  • Familiarity with Oracle ERP Cloud and SFDC release feature review and technical impact assessment.
  • Experience integrating automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or equivalent).
  • Familiarity with pipeline configuration: triggering regression runs on pull requests and release candidate builds.
  • Working knowledge of version control (Git / GitHub or GitLab): branching, pull requests, and code review workflows.
  • Basic scripting capability in Python, Shell, or PowerShell for test utility automation and pipeline support.
  • Understanding of containerized test environments (Docker); experience running tests in ephemeral containers is a plus.
  • Jira for defect tracking, test coverage reporting, and sprint participation.
  • Experience writing and maintaining test documentation: test plans, test cases, regression logs, and release readiness summaries.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with ERP Functional Analysts, ERP Technical Developers, and DevOps engineers.
  • Familiarity with SOX compliance, ITGC controls, and ERP change management practices.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Oracle Fusion certification or formal training in Oracle ERP Cloud modules.
  • Experience with SaaS QA automation in a high-growth technology company environment.
  • Exposure to OIC (Oracle Integration Cloud) or MuleSoft integration testing.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce test automation frameworks beyond Tosca (Selenium, Provar, or equivalent).
  • Prior experience working with AMS or managed services vendors in an ERP context.
  • Knowledge of Oracle quarterly release cycles and technical impact assessments.
  • Exposure to infrastructure-as-code or environment provisioning concepts (Terraform, Ansible).

This position is US-based and can be remote but if you live in the Bay Area, you’re welcome to work from our beautiful SF office. 

The base salary range for this full-time position is listed below. This position will also be eligible for equity and benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits.

Base Salary
$156,000—$175,500 USD

Why Discord? 

Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away!

Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond.

Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact.

The Partner Manager, USA is responsible for building and scaling a high-performing ecosystem of implementation and solution partners that directly supports the USA Enterprise sales motion.   • Partner with Customer Success to ensure smooth handover to delivery partners and to identify partner-led expansion opportunities.
  • Represent the USA partner ecosystem at regional events and partner forums; drive joint field marketing where it produces pipeline.

 

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • 5+ years experience in partner management, alliances, channel sales, or ecosystem roles within B2B SaaS.
  • Proven track record driving measurable pipeline and revenue outcomes through partners in an enterprise co-selling motion.
  • Experience working closely with Enterprise AEs on territory plans, account strategy, qualification, and complex deal execution.
  • Strong understanding of USA agency/SI landscape and enterprise digital transformation buying patterns (Australia-first a plus).

item.title: Bybit: Blockchain Risk Control Lead
item.description:
Headquarters: Europe - Remote

About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.
 
Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.
 
Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

Job Brief

We are expanding our focus to cover AI-augmented threat intelligence and post-quantum cryptographic (PQC) security. The ideal candidate will combine deep blockchain forensics expertise with working knowledge of machine learning techniques for anomaly detection, and awareness of quantum computing threats to current cryptographic foundations (ECDSA, RSA) used across blockchain ecosystems. We value candidates who can bridge academia and industry and build collaborative relationships with research institutions to accelerate the adoption of emerging cryptographic and AI-driven techniques within the company.
 

Main Responsibilities of a Blockchain Risk Control Analyst/Researcher

Your main responsibilities will include:
  • Leveraging LLM techniques to drive the development of next-generation on-chain risk identification and threat intelligence systems, including autonomous agent workflows capable of continuous monitoring, self-triggered investigation, and automated operational responses — reducing manual intervention across the full risk lifecycle from detection to resolution;
  • Leading forensic investigations on real crypto theft, fraud, and market manipulation cases, integrating AI-assisted pattern recognition to accelerate root cause analysis;
  • Researching post-quantum cryptographic algorithms (NIST PQC: ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, FALCON) and their implications for blockchain security; assessing quantum computing threats to existing cryptographic foundations (ECDSA secp256k1, hash functions) and evaluating migration paths;
  • Partnering with internal teams and external stakeholders for incident response, and engaging with academic institutions to translate frontier research into deployable security tools;
 

Key Requirements

  • You have a Master's or PhD's degree in Blockchain security, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field.
  • You are good at programming languages commonly used in blockchain analytics (e.g., SQL, Python, Javascript)
  • Experience applying machine learning or AI techniques to blockchain data analysis, fraud detection, or threat intelligence
  • A strong publication record in top-level industry or academic conferences is highly valued.
  • You have experience with blockchain monitoring/forensic tools and analytics platforms.
  • Familiarity with NIST PQC standards (ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, FALCON) and lattice/hash-based cryptography fundamentals is a plus;
  • Understanding of quantum computing threats to elliptic curve cryptography and implications for key management in Web3;
  • You have security or risk control experience as a plus.
  • You possess effective communication and collaboration abilities.
  • English is essential, and proficiency in Mandarin can be an advantage.

Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment. 
Our benefits include:
- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/bybit-blockchain-risk-control-lead

item.title: Cadence Health: Bilingual/Spanish Speaking Licensed Practical Nurse
item.description:
Headquarters: Remote

Cadence is the clinical AI company automating the treatment of chronic disease. Its Clinical Intelligence takes on the routine, high-volume work of chronic care – monitoring patients, surfacing risks, and coordinating action – so clinicians can focus on the decisions that require them. Grounded in partnerships with more than 20 leading health systems, deep EMR integrations, dedicated medical group, and experience serving a population of more than 100,000 patients, the system learns from real-world care delivery, improving as it scales. Cadence has been recognized by TIME as one of the Top 100 HealthTech Companies and by LinkedIn as a Top Startup (#4, 2025).

The Role

We’re hiring a Bilingual/Spanish Speaking Clinical Navigator (Licensed Practical Nurse) to deliver virtual chronic care support for Medicare patients enrolled in Cadence care programs.

Clinical Navigators deliver proactive, patient-centered outreach and follow-through. Depending on program needs, this role includes structured patient check-ins, coaching and goal-setting, care coordination to close gaps in care, and addressing barriers such as access to resources, transportation, or medication refills. Clinical Navigators document patient interactions in the Cadence platform and collaborate closely with the clinical team to escalate concerns and coordinate next steps, ensuring patients feel supported, informed, and engaged throughout their care journey.

Schedule

This is a full-time, remote position based in the United States. Standard working hours are Monday through Friday, with the following schedule options currently available:
  • Central Time: 9am to 6pm CT only
  • Mountain, Arizona, or Pacific Time: 8am to 5pm or 9am to 6pm

What You’ll Do

  • Conduct outbound telephonic patient outreach and provide one-on-one coaching and support to patients managing chronic conditions, including but not limited to type 2 diabetes, hypertension, and cardiovascular disease.
  • Help patients execute personalized care plans and achieve their goals by providing education and coaching focused on behavior modification, nutrition, physical activity, and self-management strategies using evidence-based techniques such as motivational interviewing and SMART goals.
  • Conduct comprehensive assessments of patients' health status, lifestyle behaviors, nutritional habits, and readiness to change.
  • Educate patients on disease management, medication adherence, symptom recognition, and prevention strategies, and execute care delivery tasks in accordance with Cadence clinical policies and established protocols, under appropriate clinical supervision.
  • Monitor patients' progress, adherence to treatment plans, and health outcomes through regular check-ins and remote monitoring tools.
  • Document patient interactions, outcomes, and follow-up plans in the Cadence platform; identify barriers to care (including social needs) and connect patients with resources or internal support pathways.
  • Collaborate in real time with clinicians and patient support teams using tools such as our Cadence Platform, Google Workspace, and Slack, and contribute feedback to improve workflows in a fast-moving, change-oriented environment.

These responsibilities are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by personnel assigned to this job classification. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of job duties performed by personnel in this classification. Other job related duties may be assigned by management.

Who You Are

  • A clinician who thrives at the intersection of rigorous care standards and a care delivery model that is still being built.
  • Skilled in patient education, coaching, and care coordination - you meet patients where they are in life, considering their age, lifestyle, and diet.
  • Disciplined in documentation and follow-through, with the attention to detail required for accurate clinical records in a remote environment.
  • Reliable and consistent in schedule adherence, with the interpersonal communication skills to build trust with patients over the phone.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote, fast-paced environment with evolving workflows, and tech-savvy enough to navigate and troubleshoot multiple systems simultaneously while keeping patients engaged.
  • Comfortable using AI-assisted clinical tools (such as Gemini or Open Evidence) to support patient interactions and surface relevant clinical context, while maintaining clinical judgment as the primary guide for every patient decision.
  • Biased toward action - you bring clinical authority to every interaction, make the call when it counts, and take ownership of outcomes.

What You Need

  • An active compact multi-state LPN/LVN license in the state where you currently reside is required.
  • At least 5 years of clinical experience as a Licensed Practical Nurse is required.
  • Remote work readiness (including stable high-speed WiFi) is required.
  • An active CA state LVN license is highly preferred.
  • Fluency in Spanish is required.
  • Experience providing patient education and support to individuals managing chronic conditions is preferred.
  • Fluency with AI-assisted clinical tools (such as Gemini, Open Evidence, or comparable platforms) and the ability to speak credibly with providers and patients about where AI supports care delivery and where human judgment remains non-negotiable.

Compensation

The anticipated salary range for this role is $26 - $30 per hour, which is based on role scope, level, and location. In addition to base compensation, this role may be eligible for incentive compensation as part of the overall total rewards package. This position is remote and based in the United States. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, skills, internal equity, and applicable law.

Benefits & Perks

  • Competitive pay & equity*
  • Fully remote
  • Comprehensive health coverage: Medical, dental & vision
  • Paid time off
  • 401k plan + matching
  • Paid parental leave
  • Home office stipend

*benefit offerings may vary depending on job profile, job level and worker type

item.title: Ping Identity: Channel Account Manager
item.description:
Headquarters: USA - Remote

About Ping Identity: 

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it. 

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear. 

While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work. 

We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management. 

We are seeking a strategic, field-facing Channel Account Manager to lead channels for Ping’s Enterprise team. Ping’s Enterprise sales team is the new-logo engine for companies with less than $2B in revenue and spans the commercial segment of the USA. This team has a track record of exceeding targets, and your role will help them to work with partners to drive a repeatable, scalable sales motion. You will spend meaningful time in the field with partner and Ping sales teams, building rep-to-rep engagement and turning joint account plans into qualified pipeline and closed business. You will also help organize regional partner engagements that bring the right teams together around target accounts and repeatable go-to-market plays. This is a builder role for someone who is thoughtful, positive, curious, and ready to turn strategy into action.

You Will:

  • Own the Enterprise partner strategy and plan, with a clear focus on new-logo acquisition, regional coverage, partner priorities, and measurable outcomes.
  • Build trusted relationships with partner executives, alliance leaders, sellers, technical teams, and delivery organizations, while working in the field with partners and Ping sales teams to identify target accounts and create joint account plans.
  • Drive rep-to-rep engagement between Ping sellers and partner sellers, helping teams identify opportunities, coordinate pursuits, and progress new-logo deals.
  • Set up and support regional partner events, including field meetings, account-mapping sessions, enablements, workshops, roundtables, and other activities designed to create partner-to-partner engagement and qualified pipeline.
  • Develop repeatable partner go-to-market plays and practical enablement that help partners position Ping Identity, engage new enterprise accounts, and progress opportunities.
  • Partner with Enterprise sales, Partner Solutions Engineering, marketing, services, and product teams to remove friction and help partners win and deliver successfully.
  • Track partner activity, event engagement, sourced and influenced pipeline, new-logo progress, and follow-through; use the data to focus time and investment where it will have the greatest impact.
  • Deliver measurable impact by expanding productive partner coverage, increasing partner-led new-logo pipeline, improving rep-to-rep engagement, and turning regional activity into repeatable growth.

You Have:

  • 10+ years of experience in channel, alliances, partner sales, or a related go-to-market role in enterprise technology.
  • Experience working with partners to acquire new customers and build sourced or influenced pipeline in the Enterprise market.
  • Experience managing or developing relationships with integrators, resellers, delivery partners, and/or distributors.
  • A track record of building partner programs, joint account plans, field motions, or other repeatable go-to-market plays—not simply managing existing relationships.
  • Strong field presence and the ability to engage credibly with partner executives, sellers, technical teams, and Ping sales leaders.
  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills, including the ability to create productive rep-to-rep conversations and turn meetings into clear next steps.
  • A positive, practical, and collaborative approach; you create momentum, follow through on commitments, and are comfortable operating in a changing environment.
  • Willingness to travel regularly and spend meaningful time with partners, customers, and internal teams in the field.

Bonus Points If You Have:

  • Experience in cybersecurity, identity and access management, or another complex enterprise technology category.
  • Experience working with both national and regional partners, or building partner coverage in new territories.
  • Experience planning and executing regional partner events, roundtables, workshops, or field marketing programs.
  • Experience creating partner enablement programs, certifications, technical workshops, or sales plays.
  • Experience working with sales development, account executives, and partner sellers to create net-new opportunities.
  • Enthusiasm for representing the company at partner forums, industry events, roundtables, and other public-facing engagements.
  • A relevant degree or equivalent experience, and/or cybersecurity or channel-related certifications.

Salary Range: $88,000–$132,000 base + Commission

In accordance with Colorado’s Equal Pay for Equal Work Act (SB 19-085) the approximate compensation range for this role in Colorado is listed above. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors, such as knowledge, skills, and abilities.

Life at Ping:

We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We’re growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that’s who we want to succeed with every day. 

Here are just a few of the things that make Ping special:

  • A company culture that empowers you to do your best work.
  • Employee Resource Groups that create a sense of belonging for everyone.
  • Regular company and team bonding events.
  • Competitive benefits and perks.
  • Global volunteering and community initiatives

Our Benefits: 

  • Generous PTO & Holiday Schedule 
  • Parental Leave
  • Progressive Healthcare Options
  • Retirement Programs
  • Opportunity for Education Reimbursement 
  • Commuter Offset (Specific locations) 

Ping is the collective sum of all our individual experiences, backgrounds and influences and we pride ourselves in growing and learning together. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse environment where everyone’s individuality is respected and everyone has an Identity. In recruiting for new colleagues, we welcome the unique contributions you can bring and encourage you to be your best self.

We are an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/ping-identity-channel-account-manager

item.title: Pinterest: Integrated Marketing Lead, UCAN Programming & Industry
item.description:
Headquarters: New York, NY, US; Remote, US

About Pinterest:

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

Pinterest's Global Business Organization partners with advertisers, agencies and the wider industry to grow Pinterest's business. This role owns how Pinterest shows up with key industry associations and on the industry's biggest stages, from 3C Ventures, the IAB, the ANA and the MMA to marquee moments like CES and POSSIBLE. You'll be the connective tissue between Pinterest's leaders and the external industry across the U.S. and Canada, shaping visibility, influence and reputation across the advertising and marketing landscape.

What you'll do:

  • Serve as Pinterest's day-to-day contact for key industry associations — including 3C Ventures, the IAB, the ANA and the MMA — leading memberships and commitments, delivering against contractual obligations, and finding new ways to grow Pinterest's visibility and influence within these organizations.
  • Know the industry and these associations inside and out: ensure Pinterest is getting the most value out of each membership, and recommend where to deepen, sustain or exit a relationship when it's no longer earning its keep.
  • Partner with Sales leadership to make sure membership benefits (introductions, visibility, data, access) are actually being used and translating into value for the business.
  • Inform Pinterest's speakership strategy and lead execution across key U.S. and Canada industry moments — including CES and POSSIBLE — sourcing, pitching and securing speaking opportunities that match the right Pinterest voices to the right stages and ladder up to business priorities.
  • Develop programming — talking points, fireside chats, client panels and more — for Pinterest's owned events and industry events across the U.S. and Canada.
  • Support programming for occasional agency events (e.g., WPP Stream) and large client moments, such as an executive panel at a major client's company-wide gathering or a top-five agency holding company event.
  • Prepare and support internal spokespeople and executives for speaking engagements, developing briefs, talking points and narratives in partnership with Comms to establish a consistent, compelling Pinterest story across every stage moment.
  • Partner with senior stakeholders across Sales, Marketing and Comms to prioritize the highest-impact opportunities and reconcile competing perspectives.
  • Track, measure and report on the value and impact of memberships, event investments and speaking engagements, and use those insights to recommend where to deepen, sustain or exit commitments.
  • Use AI to accelerate research, speaker briefing prep, event planning and reporting, while applying judgment and verification to establish correctness and quality.

What we're looking for:

  • Minimum of 8 years of experience in integrated marketing, industry relations, communications or event marketing, with expertise in sourcing and shaping speaking opportunities at major industry events.
  • Experience managing industry association memberships or similar external relationships, including evaluating their value and making recommendations on where to invest or pull back.
  • Experience preparing spokespeople and executives for stage moments, including developing briefs, talking points and narratives in partnership with communications teams.
  • Experience leading the end-to-end delivery of events and activations, including sponsorships, panels, logistics, budgets and timelines across multiple moments at once.
  • Experience building effective relationships with senior stakeholders, including Sales leadership, and reconciling perspectives to prioritize the highest-impact work with limited guidance.
  • Expertise in written and verbal communication, with the ability to represent a company credibly to external organizations, clients and agency partners.
  • Demonstrated experience using AI to accelerate research, briefing and reporting, with a clear approach to validating accuracy and quality.
  • Strong track record of critical evaluation and verification of AI-assisted work, with high integrity and ownership: you protect sensitive data, avoid over-reliance on AI and remain accountable for final decisions and deliverables.
  • Willingness to travel for key industry events, client events and speaking engagements as needed.
  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as marketing or communications, or equivalent experience.

Relocation Statement:

  • This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.

In-Office Requirement Statement:

  • We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day-to-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role.
  • This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 1-2 times/month and therefore can be situated anywhere in the country. 

 

#LI-REMOTE
#LI-JH4

Information regarding the culture at Pinterest and benefits available for this position can be found here.

item.title: Mercury: Creative Director - Brand Narrative
item.description:
Headquarters: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States

In 1977, Charles and Ray Eames began a film with a picnic beside Chicago’s lakefront. Over the next nine minutes, Powers of Ten traveled out toward distant galaxies and back into the microscopic world inside a human hand. An enormous subject became a journey you could follow, built around a simple change in perspective. Images, language, movement, and sound brought the idea to life together. 

That’s the kind of creative thinking we’re looking for at Mercury: finding a compelling idea inside something complex, then bringing together the people and crafts that make it unforgettable.

We’re looking for a Creative Director to build and lead Brand Narrative, a new team within Brand Creative. You’ll turn company strategy, product truths, customer insight, and cultural observations into original concepts for our most important launches, campaigns, and brand moments. You’ll originate ideas yourself and stay closely involved as they become finished work.

Your background might be in art direction, design, or copywriting. What matters is your ability to develop exceptional concepts, recognize the best idea wherever it comes from, and bring the whole creative studio together to make it real. Whatever your starting discipline, you’ll bring deep experience in film-led storytelling.

You’ll lead Brand Narrative in close creative partnership with your peers leading Brand Design and Writing. Together, you’ll shape concepts, language, and visual expression from the beginning, bringing distinct perspectives and shared ownership to the work. You’ll contribute strong ideas of your own, invite others to challenge and improve them, and build on theirs. This is a role for someone who enjoys making work together, not developing ideas in isolation and handing them off.

You’ll also shape what Brand Narrative becomes. That means building its culture, developing its people, and establishing ways of working that make the entire studio more creatively ambitious. The opportunity is to make great work while building a team that can keep making it.

What you’ll do

In your first year, your focus will be roughly 70% leading creative development for our highest-priority launches and campaigns, and 30% building the Brand Narrative function.

  • Originate and lead big creative ideas. Partner with Product Marketing and Brand Marketing on the brief, then turn the agreed audience, opportunity, and product proof into original creative concepts. Develop ideas that can take distinctive forms across film, social, out-of-home, digital, experiences, and partnerships.
  • Bring ambitious concepts to life with your creative peers and the full studio. Work side by side with the Brand Design and Writing leads and their teams from the earliest explorations through delivery. Develop ideas together, exchange thoughtful critique, and make creative choices that draw on each discipline’s expertise. Stay hands-on, contribute through your own craft, and partner closely with Motion and Production throughout. For film, remain closely involved through scripts, visual development, production, and the final edit.
  • Build audience and distribution thinking into the idea. Shape concepts around how people will discover, watch, and share the work. Work with marketing partners to consider channels and viewing contexts from the beginning, so the work belongs where people encounter it rather than simply being resized to fit.
  • Push beyond the first good answer, and learn quickly. Lead thoughtful concept development and critique. Use rough scripts, prototypes, and AI tools to test ideas quickly, learn, and move the strongest work forward. Know when to keep exploring and when to commit, then protect what makes an idea interesting through feedback and production.
  • Find opportunities before a brief arrives. Bring curiosity about Mercury’s products, customers, and the wider world. Develop proactive ideas and cultural opportunities that give the brand something meaningful to say or do.
  • Help decide where creative ambition matters most. Partner early with Product Marketing, Brand Marketing, Product Design, Comms, and Insights. Help identify which moments deserve our largest creative investment, present recommendations to senior leadership, and use results from marketing and insights partners to inform what comes next.
  • Build and lead Brand Narrative. Define the team’s purpose, priorities, creative standards, and ways of working. Help hire and develop the team, shaping its structure and capabilities. Set clear expectations, and coach people to grow their judgment and conceptual strength.
  • Create a culture where the best idea wins. Make room for experimentation, honest feedback, and contributions across disciplines. Lead with generosity and conviction, share ownership of the work, and help people challenge one another without making creativity a competition for credit.
  • Build practices that strengthen the work. Establish a clear path from insight and an agreed brief to concept and execution, with useful critique and close collaboration throughout. Develop relationships with external creatives and agencies who can add a distinctive perspective or capability when needed.

What you’ll bring

  • A strong creative foundation in art direction, design, or copywriting. Your portfolio shows original concepts developed into ambitious, well-crafted work across multiple formats. You can explain what you contributed, how the idea evolved, and how collaboration made it better.
  • Deep film experience. You’ve developed film-led ideas from concept through production, with strong instincts for story, scripts, performance, pacing, and sound. You understand how these choices work together to make an audience feel something, not just make a film look good.
  • A track record of deep creative collaboration with design and writing peers. You’ve led ambitious multidisciplinary work from concept through production by building trusted partnerships. You bring a clear point of view, listen closely, work through creative disagreements constructively, and recognize when someone else’s approach makes the work stronger. You can show how your collaborators shaped the outcome, not just what you personally originated.
  • Strong taste, cultural awareness, and product curiosity. You can get close to a complex business or product, find the human truth within it, and turn that understanding into something clear, surprising, and memorable.
  • Experience developing creative people and shaping how a team works. You give specific, useful feedback, set a high bar with care, and create an environment where people can take creative risks. You’re excited to build a new function, including the everyday practices that give it a culture.
  • Clear communication and sound judgment. You can rally people around an ambitious concept, explain why it deserves investment, and navigate competing perspectives without losing the idea. You take ownership in ambiguous situations and balance creative ambition with the need to move work forward.

What success looks like

A year in, you’ll have led major launches and film-led campaigns from original concept through finished work, with Brand Design and Writing as creative partners from the beginning. The studio’s disciplines will have shaped the work together, with audience and distribution informing the creative approach.

Brand Narrative will have a clear identity, shared creative standards, and working practices that help people test and develop stronger ideas together. Alongside planned launches, you’ll have established a pipeline of proactive opportunities that gives Mercury more ways to express its product ambition with originality and cultural relevance.

Please include a portfolio featuring film-led work and broader campaign concepts. We’d love to understand your role in developing the ideas, the choices you made through production, and how you brought the work to life with others.

All individuals seeking employment at Mercury are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities or special needs. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.
