item.title: DuckDuckGo: Senior Backend Engineer
item.description:
Headquarters: Paoli, Pennsylvania
URL: https://duckduckgo.com

Who We Are

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 400+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, our annual revenue is in the hundreds of millions USD and millions use our browser on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, our search engine, and the DuckDuckGo subscription. We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai, which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place.

 

Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!

 

Your Team and Role

Working on the Backend Functional Team, you'll lead complex projects across key company-wide objectives. Using Perl (Version 5), Go, and Node.js, you’ll write pragmatic, performant, testable code that works consistently, and work on related projects. Recent projects include:

  • Implementing AI-assisted answers and integrating them into our Search product while maintaining our privacy-first approach

  • Delivering improvements to Duck.ai to help us make it a competitive AI chat alternative for both free and paying users

  • Implementing sophisticated data processing pipelines that maintain search relevancy

 

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll collaborate remotely with your peers and take responsibility for solving product issues impacting our all-in-one privacy solution, whether large or small. In time, you'll formally mentor other engineers, supporting their career growth and the growth of the Backend Team at DuckDuckGo.

 

About You

  • 7+ years of professional experience, primarily focused on backend systems that power consumer-facing products

  • Product acumen to reason about technical tradeoffs in terms of user impact

  • Familiarity with AI agent tooling: evaluation frameworks, RAG pipelines and prompt engineering

  • A fundamental understanding of complex data structures and algorithms — you can develop and apply new solutions and confidently navigate and improve existing code.

  • Data-driven analytical skills for decision-making, stakeholder alignment, and experiment-oriented delivery

  • Solid project management abilities

  • Excellent written and verbal communication to validate and articulate decisions

  • Previous experience leading and mentoring experienced engineers, supporting their career goals, and unlocking their potential.

 

Compensation

This role is paid on a regional pay scale, in local currency, and stock options:

  • United States: $190,500 USD annually

  • United Kingdom: £134,600 GBP annually

  • Canada: C$253,500 CAD annually

  • Europe/Rest of World: €157,350 EUR annually

In Spain, pay is expected to transition to the EUR scale on January 1, 2027, and in other Europe/Rest of World countries on February 1, 2027.

 

Compensation is transparent across the organization, and all team members within the same professional level and global region receive the same compensation.

 

Eligibility for company-sponsored health benefits is limited to team members based in the United States. This program does not extend to team members located in other countries, such as Canada or the UK.

 

Our Team Member Support Guide explains how we prioritize your wellbeing including paid parental leave, office setup, and co-working allowances.

 

 

Hiring Process

Hiring works best when it's a two-way street. Learn how we help you get to know DuckDuckGo, envision your future role here, and find out more about how we hire.

 

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

DuckDuckGo provides equal work opportunities to all team members and applicants, and it prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, caste, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by our policies or federal, state, or local laws.

 

We want to ensure that our hiring process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process because of a medical condition or disability, please send an email to careers@duckduckgo.com to let us know the nature of your request.

 

Please note that:

  • You’ll be required to attend meetings on camera via video conferencing

  • Expect to travel at least two times a year: once for our all-hands meetup and again for a team retreat (each around 4-5 days). While extenuating circumstances may impact attendance, everyone is strongly encouraged to attend.

  • While we offer a flexible work arrangement with no core hours, expect an average full-time commitment of 40 hours per week.

  • A successful candidate must pass a background check as a condition of joining the team.

  • By applying for this role, you confirm that all information submitted is accurate and complete. You further acknowledge that providing false or fraudulent information during the application process is cause for denial of an offer, revocation of any existing offer, or other adverse action, up to and including termination after the start of your commencement of work.

 

Disclosure Statement: Use of AI in Hiring Process

As part of our commitment to enhancing our recruitment process, we utilize artificial intelligence (AI) technology to assist in reviewing and summarizing job applications and test projects, including those tools integrated into our recruitment vendor platforms. We use AI to flag potentially fraudulent applications, analyze and summarize applicants’ experience, interviews, and project performance, and help streamline our selection process.

Key Principles:

  • Data Privacy: All information provided in your application will be handled in accordance with our Recruiting Privacy Policy. We ensure that your personal information is protected and used solely for recruitment purposes.

  • Human Oversight and Accountability: The AI technology is designed to support our hiring team by providing insights and summaries of applications and evaluations of test projects against scoring rubrics. All final evaluations and hiring decisions, however, will be made by our hiring team, who will consider the AI's input alongside other factors.

  • Transparency: We believe in transparency regarding our hiring practices. If you have any questions about how AI is used in our recruitment process, please feel free to reach out to us.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge and consent to the use of AI technology in our review process. If you would like to request an alternative selection process, please contact us as at careers@duckduckgo.com. Thank you for your interest in joining DuckDuckGo!

URL: https://lemon.io

Lemon.io helps companies in the US and Europe hire experienced engineers, from funded startups to teams like Klarna, Retool, and Pinterest. We’ve been doing this since 2015, and more than 1,500 companies have hired engineers through us.

New roles for Senior Angular Engineers come in all the time, and several are open right now.

Two ways to work with clients

  • Contract: most roles are contract-based. You join the client’s team and work as part of it.
  • Direct hire: some clients hire engineers full-time, and we support you through the process.

Because companies trust our vetting, applying through Lemon.io is often a shortcut. You get to the client faster than going through their full hiring process on your own.

What you get

  • Competitive rate, based on your seniority and skills
  • We find the projects. No client hunting or rate negotiations. We match you manually based on your skills and preferences.
  • Flexible schedule. Work async or with a small overlap with the team’s hours.
  • No micromanagement, no screen trackers
  • Direct work with clients, most of them with technical backgrounds
  • Ongoing support from your application through every project, plus a community of engineers from 75+ countries

Who we’re looking for

  • 4+ years of software development experience

  • 2+ years of experience with Nuxt.js & JavaScript

    OR
    5+ years of experience with Vue.js & 3+ years with .NET

Requirements for Senior Vue.js & Python Developer:

  • You own problems end-to-end: you spot the issue, design and build the solution, and ship it to production
  • You can show the business impact of your work with concrete results (e.g., faster processing, lower costs, more users, fewer incidents)
  • Advanced English: you discuss business tasks, explain your decisions, raise issues early, and present yourself and your results well on client calls
  • You work full-time remotely and deliver without supervision
  • You onboard quickly and start shipping in your first weeks

How it works

  1. Apply and complete your profile

item.title: Upsun: Product Manager
item.description:
Headquarters: Remote • Germany, Canada, France, Spain or the UK

About Upsun (formerly Platform.sh) 

Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love. It is built for today’s hybrid teams, where AI agents write and test code and humans focus on solving the problems that really matter. Developers, DevOps engineers, and platform teams use Upsun to build, ship, and scale confidently without wrestling with backend infrastructure. We give you your time back. You get:

  • Predictable performance, even at scale
  • Secure, compliant environments by default 
  • Real-time observability and profiling built in
  • Cloning, configuration, and provisioning in seconds 
  • AI-ready features that plug directly into your stack

The name says it all. "Up" means uptime, reliability, and acceleration. "Sun" reflects our follow-the-sun-support, a 24x7, globally distributed support team keeping the lights on while you rest. Our core belief is that software should power brighter solutions and greater innovation.

Upsunners are a remote, global workforce, and we thrive in a multicultural team. We are committed to open source and an open, welcoming environment. Our team spans the globe and the experience spectrum.

What's our commonality, our cultural fabric? A curious spirit and a thirst for knowledge; an eagerness for innovative ideas and cultures. We believe we can build anything together in an environment that frees you to do your best work.

Our values: 

We make a positive impact.

We aim for the stars.

We care for each other. 

Impact of a Product Manager

As a Product Manager at Upsun, you own a significant area of Upsun Cloud, our cloud application platform, and the outcomes it delivers for the developers who build on it. The team you join owns the platform's foundations: the API, the runtime, environments, and the reliability every application running on Upsun depends on. And because Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love, much of what you build will be used by AI agents as much as by people.

This is a hands-on, technically rich role that bridges product strategy and deep infrastructure understanding. You own the strategy and the roadmap for your area, working closely with engineering to define platform behavior, build scalable abstractions, and shape workflows that empower modern development teams. Throughout, you act as the key voice for the user, making sure everything we ship contributes meaningfully to an exceptional developer experience.

What to expect

  • Strategy and roadmap: Own the strategy, roadmap, and priorities for your area of Upsun Cloud, balancing established foundations with uncharted territory.

  • Problem definition: Synthesize inputs from customers, support, sales, and engineering into clear problem statements, constructively testing underlying assumptions.

  • Solution definition: Explore options with your team, weigh trade-offs, and land on the right scope.

  • Ship small, iterate fast: Release in increments and shorten the loop between shipping and learning.

  • Technical execution: Collaborate with engineering (especially infrastructure and systems teams) to deliver platform capabilities that are reliable, scalable, and developer-friendly.

  • Design for humans and agents: Build with two audiences in mind—ensuring features, APIs, documentation, and error messages serve both people and AI agents.

  • Customer and data authority: Connect with customers regularly, serve as an internal advocate for their needs, and define metrics that demonstrate value for users and the business.

  • Influence across teams: Build alignment across engineering, design, Product Marketing, support, and leadership.

  • Go-to-market: Partner with Product Marketing early so go-to-market strategy helps shape the product, not just the launch.

What you bring

  • Product management experience: Proven experience in product management owning a distinct product area, ideally focused on developer platforms, PaaS, or cloud infrastructure.

  • Technical depth: Understanding of building, deploying, and running applications in the cloud, with the ability to collaborate closely with infrastructure engineers on multi-tenant architectures or distributed systems.

  • Software development background: Familiarity with building software using languages such as Python, Ruby, JavaScript, PHP, Go, or Rust.

  • CI/CD, containers & APIs: Hands-on experience or close collaboration with CI/CD workflows, Docker/OCI container technologies, and a clear vision for intuitive API design.

  • AI fluency: Daily use of modern AI tools to research, draft, and prototype workflows, paired with a realistic understanding of where current tools and models fall short.

  • Agentic development: A strong perspective on autonomous agent architecture and how agentic workflows are transforming modern software engineering.

  • Navigating ambiguity: Comfort with turning unstructured problem spaces into clear strategies and taking thoughtful action even with incomplete information.

  • Collaborative communication: Clear written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of listening, building consensus, and uniting teams around a shared vision.

  • Data-informed decision making: Ability to seek out and evaluate data to guide decisions and track success.

Bonus points for

  • Enthusiasm for using and testing the platform capabilities you help build.

  • Experience using Kubernetes, or building self-service platforms on Kubernetes

Where we hire

At Upsun, remote work isn't just a trend - it's our foundation. The freedom of remote work with the support of a diverse, global team has been our successful model for over a decade. Our culture celebrates flexibility and collaboration, and while we have team members in over 30 countries around the globe, we are currently focused on hiring for this role in Germany, Canada, Spain, France, and the UK. Although we’re unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates who are legally authorized to work in these countries. 

How we hire

We know that a great hire won’t meet every requirement that we’ve outlined. If you can see yourself elevating the team, we want to hear your story. Few of us would be here had we not taken a chance.   

You can expect 5 video interviews on Google Meet to follow the order below. Should you successfully move through the entire process you will have the opportunity to meet with a variety of Upsunners. Our goal is to ensure you can make the most informed decision on whether this role, and our culture aligns with what you’re looking for in your future working environment. 

  1. 45 Minutes with Talent Acquisition 
  2. 60 Minutes with Hiring Manager (Director, Product)
  3. 60 Minutes with Team (IC's)
  4. 60 Minutes with Product Leaders
  5. 45 Minutes with Executive (CTO)

All roles require background checks.

What we offer

A product you can believe in - Join us in transforming how businesses build and manage web applications, driven making a positive impact as a proud B Corp.

An Award-Winning Workplace - We’ve been recognized by Forbes’ Top 30 Companies for Remote Jobs and France’s Best Workplaces for Women.

️ A culture that values your voice - Join a flexible, open, and inclusive work environment where your voice is encouraged, and your ideas shape our growth and evolution.

A global team - Collaborate with colleagues from diverse backgrounds across the world, embracing different perspectives

Benefits and perks - Make the most of what matters to you

Flexible PTO

Comprehensive healthcare coverage (UK, Canada, France, Spain, USA)

Company stock options

Professional development budget

Office equipment budget

‍️ Wellness budget

Annual team gatherings

Internet reimbursement

Inclusive parental leave

️ Remote work travel program

You belong here

At Upsun, we celebrate diversity in all its forms and are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and supportive workplace where everyone can thrive. We embrace and value different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences, because they make us stronger as a team. Whoever you are, wherever you're from, and whatever path you've taken, you are welcome here. We encourage you to bring your whole self to work, connect with others, and share your passion. If you need accommodations at any stage of our hiring process, please let us know. We're here to ensure an accessible and comfortable experience for you.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/upsun-product-manager

item.title: Duolingo: Director of Ad Sales - West
item.description:
Headquarters: Remote - California

Our mission at Duolingo is to develop the best education in the world and make it universally available. It’s a big mission, and that’s where you come in!

At Duolingo, you’ll join a team that cares about educating our users, experimenting with big ideas, making fact-based decisions, and finding innovative solutions to complex problems. You’ll have limitless learning opportunities and daily collaborations with world-class minds — while doing work that’s both meaningful and fun.

Join our life-changing mission to develop education for our half a billion (and growing!) learners around the world. 

Read our blog to learn more.

About the role...

Join us to build Duolingo Ads, Duolingo’s direct ad business. Most learners use our free, ad‑supported app—so great ads are core to our mission. We’re hiring a Head of West Coast Sales to open and scale our West Coast region. You will set regional strategy, build and lead a high‑performing team, and own revenue outcomes across priority verticals and agency holding companies. As a player/coach, you’ll cultivate senior‑level relationships, shape pricing and packaging with leadership, and close high‑impact deals that both delight learners and drive revenue while leading a team of sellers. This is a high‑ownership, early‑stage opportunity to help define how ads show up for hundreds of millions of learners while building a repeatable, data‑driven go‑to‑market.

  You will...

  • Own West Coast revenue targets and forecasting; build a healthy, predictable pipeline across named accounts and agency groups, and deliver against quarterly goals.
  • Develop and execute the regional go‑to‑market strategy, including territory design, vertical focus, pricing/packaging inputs, and coverage plans as we scale.
  • Hire, coach, and lead a small team of sellers over time; establish operating rhythms, deal reviews, and CRM hygiene standards that improve forecast accuracy and execution.
  • Build and deepen senior relationships at brands and agencies; open new logos and expand strategic accounts with clear commercial narratives that map Duolingo’s unique strengths (design, IP, native formats) to client objectives.
  • Lead complex deals end‑to‑end—from prospecting and positioning through negotiation, close, renewal, and expansion—partnering tightly with Account Management and Ad Ops for flawless delivery.
  • Share actionable market feedback with sales and product leadership to inform pricing, packaging, measurement, and ad experiences while protecting the learner experience.
  • Operate with speed and rigor in a startup‑like environment, building repeatable sales motions, outreach cadences, and team practices that scale from 0→1 and 1→N.

 

  You have...

  • 8+ years of direct digital ad sales experience with a consistent track record of hunting, closing, and renewing in premium mobile or consumer app environments.
  • Success selling video and native/custom formats and structuring innovative agreements with top‑tier advertisers and agencies.
  • Proven ability to engage senior decision makers while rolling up your sleeves to build collateral, troubleshoot issues, and drive revenue personally.
  • Strong understanding of ad tech and mobile app ecosystems, with skill using data to assess performance and inform pricing and packaging.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, and comfort operating with ambiguity at high velocity.

 

⭐  Exceptional candidates will have...

  • Established relationships across West Coast brand and agency decision makers.
  • Experience introducing or scaling a new ads product from 0→1 within a publisher or platform environment.
  • Experience shaping regional GTM, sales process, or coverage models beyond an individual book of business.
  • Familiarity partnering with Account Management and Ad Ops on native/custom programs and live‑campaign storytelling to drive renewals.
  • Vertical expertise in Entertainment, Gaming, Streaming, or Tech that accelerates early traction.

The offered salary is dependent upon several factors, including work experience, skills, and internal peer comparisons. The posted range is subject to change in the future. For this role, base salary is supplemented by equity compensation. We encourage you to talk with your recruiter for more information related to compensation for this role!

Salary Range:
$183,200—$274,800 USD

Benefits: Take a peek at how we care for our employees' holistic well-being with our benefits here.

Job Alerts: Sign up for job alerts here.

Accommodations: We will do everything we can within reason to make sure that your interview takes place in an environment that fairly and accurately assesses your skills. If you need assistance or accommodation, please contact accommodations@duolingo.com.

Equal Employment Opportunity: Duolingo is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Fraud Warning: Unfortunately, there is a rise in scammers pretending to be real Duolingo employees. Duolingo and our employees will never ask for your Social Security number, bank details, or passport info, and we’ll never ask you to deposit a check, purchase equipment, or exchange money during the interview process. Real Duolingo employees always use an email that ends in @duolingo.com or @recruiting.duolingo.com. Stay alert and double-check these details before sharing any information.

item.title: Ritual: Core Protocol Engineer
item.description:
Headquarters: Remote

About Ritual 

Ritual is building a sovereign, execution layer for AI, with our private testnet already live and running. The Ritual chain is the first blockchain custom-built to support AI-native operations, designed from the ground up to enable a new class of applications at the intersection of crypto and AI. Our first product, Infernet, is pioneering new ground as the first solution to enable developers to access AI models both on-chain via smart contracts and off-chain, demonstrating our commitment to bridging these transformative technologies.

About the role

We're seeking a Core Protocol Engineer with deep expertise with Ethereum execution clients to help us extend the EVM for next-generation compute capabilities. You'll work on expanding the execution layer to support novel precompiles, implement parallel execution patterns, and design systems for heterogeneous compute orchestration.

  • Design and implement extensions to EVM clients (Geth/Reth) for supporting stateful precompiles
  • Implement novel mechanism design primitives, collaborating with our research team, into the execution layer
  • Develop and optimize transaction processing pipelines for heterogeneous workloads
  • Research and implement solutions for state access conflicts
  • Contribute to core protocol development and EIP implementations
  • Collaborate with the research team on protocol specifications and mechanism design improvements
  • Design and implement robust testing frameworks for execution client modifications

About you

  • Deep understanding of EVM internals and Ethereum execution clients (Geth/Reth)
  • Strong experience implementing and optimizing precompiles
  • Expertise in Go and/or Rust for systems programming, and Solidity
  • Thorough knowledge of Ethereum's roadmap and active participation in protocol discussions
  • Experience with parallel execution patterns in blockchain systems
  • Strong understanding of consensus mechanisms and blockchain architecture
  • Ability to read, understand, and implement EIPs and protocol specifications
  • Proven track record of shipping production-grade blockchain systems
  • Ability to act quickly under high pressure scenarios and context switch at a high frequency
  • A high level of end-to-end ownership and self-direction, with excellent communication skills
  • Hungry, high-energy and ability to work within and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment

Nice to have

  • Knowledge of mempool dynamics, transaction ordering and the mev-boost implementation
  • Background in mechanism design or market systems
  • Deep knowledge of proof systems and their trade-offs around prover time, verifier time, and proof size
  • Experience optimizing proof generation and verification pipelines
  • Experience with cross-chain bridges or interoperability protocols
  • Contributions to Ethereum client codebases
  • Background in distributed systems and concurrent programming

Why join us 

  • Join a passionate group of engineers, researchers, and operators on a mission to build the next generation of AI infrastructure 
  • Highly competitive compensation package, including annual discretionary bonus & optimized tax structure compared to the vast majority of web3 startups
  • Top 1% of benefits across the web3 startup space
  • 100% of premiums covered on highest quality healthcare 
  • Aggressive company 401k match
  • Fully remote and/or hybrid, up to you!
  • Participate in virtual and in-person events
  • Much much more!

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/ritual-core-protocol-engineer

item.title: Ping Identity: Chief of Staff, CCO
item.description:
Headquarters: USA - Remote

About Ping Identity: 

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it. 

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear. 

While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work. 

We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management. 

We are seeking a strategic and analytical Chief of Staff to partner with our Chief Customer Officer (CCO) in driving business performance across our Customer organization. This role combines financial and operational strategy, data-driven decision-making, and cross-functional collaboration to improve customer retention, revenue performance, and organizational effectiveness.

The ideal candidate brings strong financial and business acumen, a collaborative mindset, and the ability to translate complex information into actionable insights that inform executive decisions and strengthen financial and operational accountability.

What You'll Do

  • Customer revenue metrics: In partnership with Finance, which owns ARR and financial reporting, to ensure customer metrics (ARR movement, gross and net revenue retention, renewal rates on up for renewal revenue, cohort views and churn drivers) follow Thoma Bravo standards and best-in-class methods. Translates those metrics into the customer organization's view, measures renewal forecast accuracy, and reports on cross-sell and upsell pipeline, which Renewals and Sales own.
  • Executive and board narrative: Prepares the CCO's materials for the executive leadership team, board, Thoma Bravo operating reviews and QBRs, framing performance, risk and investment asks in terms of business outcomes. Ensures what the board sees reconciles to how the organization operates.
  • Renewal and retention reporting: Owns renewal rate reporting and variance analysis of the official forecast against plan and actuals, explaining the drivers behind the numbers.
  • Renewal and retention plan and resource models: In partnership with Finance, builds the customer organization's annual renewal and retention plan (historical baselines, renewal rate assumptions and targets) and the headcount, coverage-ratio and capacity models tied to book-of-business segmentation.
  • Customer health and signals: Delivers the customer health scoring model and churn and risk analysis.
  • Customer reporting requirements and CCO analysis: Sets the customer organization's reporting requirements across Salesforce, the data warehouse and BI tools, aligned with Finance's metric definitions, which Systems & Operations and Data & Analytics build to. Handles the CCO's own analysis and reporting requests.
  • Cross-functional Alignment: Works with Revenue Operations and CRO leadership team to align on strategies and reporting for improving Net Retention Rate. Works with the Product Strategy team to align on churn analysis and forecasting by product.

What You'll Bring

  • Significant experience in strategic finance, FP&A, business operations, revenue operations, customer success operations, or a related field, ideally within a B2B SaaS environment.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS business models and recurring revenue metrics, including ARR, GRR, NRR, renewals, and churn.
  • Experience translating business needs into reporting and analytics requirements, with familiarity using tools such as Salesforce, Excel, SQL, Power BI, or Tableau.
  • Ability to analyze complex datasets and communicate insights clearly to executive audiences.
  • Familiarity with CRM, reporting, and business intelligence tools such as Salesforce, Excel, SQL, Power BI, or Tableau.
  • Strong collaboration, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to influence across teams.
  • Experience in private equity-backed environments or supporting executive and board-level reporting is a plus.

Salary Range: $155,628 - $207,504

In accordance with Colorado’s Equal Pay for Equal Work Act (SB 19-085) the approximate compensation range for this role in Colorado is listed above. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors, such as knowledge, skills, and abilities.

Life at Ping:

We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We’re growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that’s who we want to succeed with every day. 

Here are just a few of the things that make Ping special:

  • A company culture that empowers you to do your best work.
  • Employee Resource Groups that create a sense of belonging for everyone.
  • Regular company and team bonding events.
  • Competitive benefits and perks.
  • Global volunteering and community initiatives

Our Benefits: 

  • Generous PTO & Holiday Schedule 
  • Parental Leave
  • Progressive Healthcare Options
  • Retirement Programs
  • Opportunity for Education Reimbursement 
  • Commuter Offset (Specific locations) 

Ping is the collective sum of all our individual experiences, backgrounds and influences and we pride ourselves in growing and learning together. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse environment where everyone’s individuality is respected and everyone has an Identity. In recruiting for new colleagues, we welcome the unique contributions you can bring and encourage you to be your best self.

We are an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/ping-identity-chief-of-staff-cco

item.title: Ritual: Controller
item.description:
Headquarters: Remote

About Ritual 

Ritual is building a sovereign, execution layer for AI, with our private testnet already live and running. The Ritual chain is the first blockchain custom-built to support AI-native operations, designed from the ground up to enable a new class of applications at the intersection of crypto and AI. Our first product, Infernet, is pioneering new ground as the first solution to enable developers to access AI models both on-chain via smart contracts and off-chain, demonstrating our commitment to bridging these transformative technologies.

About the role

We’re looking for a hands-on Controller to build and oversee our financial operations as we scale.

You’ll work directly with the founders and leadership team to manage all accounting, financial reporting, and compliance functions across both fiat and crypto assets.
This is a high-ownership role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and wants to help shape the financial foundation of a next-generation technology company.

  • Oversee all financial operations and serve as the internal owner for accounting, treasury, and financial reporting, while coordinating execution with external accounting and tax partners.

  • Maintain robust internal controls over fiat and digital assets, ensuring proper reconciliation, documentation, and authorization processes.

  • Manage company treasury, including crypto and fiat holdings, stablecoin liquidity, and vendor payments.

  • Monitor and report financial position, cash runway, and budget-to-actual performance for management and investors.

  • Own financial systems and process design, implementing efficient tools for expense tracking, payments, and internal reporting.

  • Coordinate financial reporting cycles (monthly/quarterly/annual close) with external partners to ensure timely and accurate statements.

  • Support token operations, including warrant tracking, token vesting, treasury management, and coordination with token administration platforms.

item.title: Asana: Customer Enablement Manager
item.description:
Headquarters: Remote

As a Customer Enablement Manager, you will partner with complex enterprise customers to transform how work gets done across their organizations. You will own a portfolio of strategic customers, providing a variety of enablement activities, including discovery, workflow consultation, change management, strategic enablement, and scalable education to accelerate adoption and measurable business outcomes.

You will work closely with Customer Success, Sales, and Services to understand customer priorities, diagnose barriers to adoption, and recommend strategies that help organizations adopt new workflows and AI-enabled ways of working. As a senior individual contributor, you will serve as a trusted advisor to customers and internal partners, navigate complex stakeholder environments, and help shape repeatable approaches that strengthen Asana's broader Customer Enablement practice.

This role is West Coast based remote and is open to employees in Pacific or Mountain Standard time.

What you'll achieve

  • Strategic Trusted Advisory: Develop a deep understanding of customer business priorities, operating models, and ways of working. Lead discovery with complex stakeholders and translate customer challenges into clear recommendations for workflow, enablement, and adoption strategies that drive measurable business value.
  • Own Complex Customer Engagements: Independently manage complex enterprise engagements within your portfolio of strategic customers, from discovery and planning through delivery, measurement, and follow-through. Navigate ambiguity, competing priorities, and multi-stakeholder environments while keeping engagements aligned to customer and account outcomes.
  • Drive Workflow and AI Transformation: Help customers rethink how work gets done by translating Asana and AI capabilities into practical, scalable use cases. Guide customers through the people, process, and behavior change required to successfully adopt new ways of working.
  • Executive and High-Impact Facilitation: Design and facilitate workflow consultations, strategic workshops, enablement programs, and executive-level conversations for audiences ranging from end users and champions to senior leaders. Adapt your approach based on customer maturity, organizational complexity, and desired outcomes.
  • Measure and Optimize Customer Impact: Use adoption, engagement, and efficacy data to assess whether enablement is driving meaningful behavior change and business outcomes. Identify trends, adjust engagement strategies, and use insights to strengthen customer plans and CEM programs.
  • Strengthen Customer Partnerships and Commercial Outcomes: Identify risks, expansion opportunities, and new use cases through your customer engagements. Partner with account teams to connect adoption and enablement strategies to retention, expansion, and long-term customer value.

About you

  • 6+ years of experience in customer enablement, customer success, strategic consulting, implementation, change management, professional services, or a related customer-facing role, ideally within SaaS.
  • Demonstrated experience independently leading complex enterprise customer engagements that combine discovery, consultation, facilitation, and enablement to drive adoption, behavior change, or business transformation.
  • Strong consultative skills with the ability to uncover root causes, synthesize complex information, challenge assumptions constructively, and translate ambiguity into clear recommendations and action plans.
  • Experience engaging and influencing senior and executive stakeholders, including navigating competing priorities and building alignment across diverse stakeholder groups.
  • Excellent facilitation and communication skills, with the ability to lead strategic conversations and high-impact sessions for audiences ranging from practitioners to executives.
  • Strong project and portfolio management skills, with a track record of independently managing multiple complex customer engagements and driving work forward without significant oversight.
  • Strong commercial acumen and an understanding of how adoption, customer value, retention, expansion, and organizational change are connected.
  • Strong product and technical curiosity, with the ability to quickly develop expertise in new technology and translate AI and workflow capabilities into meaningful customer use cases.
  • Data-informed and outcomes-oriented, with experience using customer signals and metrics to evaluate impact, identify risks, and adjust strategy.
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional partners and contribute to improvements in programs, processes, playbooks, or customer strategy beyond your own individual accounts.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-moving and ambiguous environment, exercising strong judgment, prioritization, and ownership.
  • Collaborative teammate who actively mentors others, shares expertise, and helps raise the quality and consistency of the broader team's work.

At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

What we'll offer

Our comprehensive compensation package plays a big part in how we recognize you for the impact you have on our path to achieving our mission. We believe that compensation should be reflective of the value you create relative to the market value of your role. To ensure pay is fair and not impacted by biases, we're committed to looking at market value, which is why we check ourselves and conduct a yearly pay equity audit.

For this role, the estimated base salary range is between [comp range]. The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. The listed range above is a guideline, and the base salary range for this role may be modified.

In addition to base salary, your compensation package may include additional components such as equity, sales incentive pay (for most sales roles), and benefits. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.

We strive to provide equitable and competitive benefits packages that support our employees worldwide and include:

  • Mental health, wellness & fitness benefits
  • Career coaching & support
  • Inclusive family building benefits

  • In-office culinary options to cater to your dietary preferences

These are just some of the benefits we offer, and benefits may vary based on role, country, and local regulations. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.

Asana is a leading platform for human + AI collaboration. Millions of teams around the world rely on Asana to achieve their most important goals, faster. Asana has been named to Fortune's Best Workplaces for 7+ years and recognized by Fast Company, Forbes, and Gartner for excellence in workplace culture and innovation. We offer an exceptional office-centric culture while adopting the best elements of hybrid models to ensure that every one of our global team members can work together effortlessly. With 13+ offices all over the world, we are always looking for individuals who care about building technology that drives positive change in the world and a culture where everyone feels that they belong.

item.title: Cribl: Analytics Business Partner
item.description:
Headquarters: Remote - United States

Join the company that’s building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era. At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world’s biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what’s next.

We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we’re remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd.

Why You’ll Love This Role

At Cribl, we're transforming from a flagship-product company into a multi-product powerhouse - and every non-routine business event, whether an acquisition, a product launch, or a go-to-market shift, adds complexity our data, definitions, and reporting weren't built to handle. As the Analytics Business Partner, you're the person who closes that gap - translating a new product or customer into our existing data, systems and reporting: how it connects to what we already have, how value is attributed, how we define and track it going forward. Reporting to the VP of Data & Analytics — part of Cribl's broader Business Operations organization alongside Strategy & Operations and Business Effectiveness — you'll operate horizontally across the business rather than embedding in a single function.

This is a high-impact role for a strategist who thrives on ambiguity and builds order from chaos. If you are eager to contribute to a company poised for generational success, we want to hear from you. 


As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will…

  • Diagnose and Drive the Solution. When a non-routine business event doesn't fit with how we currently track or report on the business, define the solution. Whether a system change, a new process or policy, or a different data model, serve as the Directly Responsible Individual (DRI) for working with the necessary x-functional teams to get it delivered
  • M&A Integration. When we acquire a company, own and drive how its products and customers fit into our existing reporting and data models, ensuring we can capture the impact of the acquisition post deal close
  • New Product Launch. When we launch a new product, understand how Product defines its success metrics, and make sure our models, definitions, and reporting can track against those metrics post launch
  • Keep Execution Moving. When a change spans across the Data and Analytics team (Data Engineering, Analytics, Data Science, Data Governance), sequence who does what first, own the handoffs between them, catch duplication or gaps before they cost the team time, and push the pace when the event demands it
  • Stand Up the Business Intelligence Council. Establish and run the forum where cross-functional leaders align on key measures, attributes, and hierarchy definitions, and on prioritization across competing data and analytics efforts — and drive it to actual resolution, rather than let it stall as a standing meeting.
  • Know The Business. Maintain a working picture of how GTM, Finance, Product, and other functions operate, knowing who to engage so a project doesn’t start or drift, without the right people engaged. For example, understanding how Product Marketing is positioning a new feature, how it needs to be represented across our applications in partnership with IT, and how Finance will measure its impact, before scoping the data work for it. 
  • We are a remote-first company and work happens across many time-zones – you may be required to occasionally perform duties outside your standard working hours

 

If You've Got It - We Want It

  • 8+ years in management consulting, in-house strategy, business operations, or business analytics, with a track record of operating in unfamiliar functions and reframing ambiguously-posed questions
  • Fluency across GTM, Finance, Product, and other functions - enough to know that 'customer' may mean something different to Sales than it does to Finance, and to reconcile the difference rather than pick a side
  • You can join multiple tables, write a CTE, and get the aggregation grain right - enough to answer your own question - though hands-on query and dashboard work won't be your primary responsibility in this role
  • Given a reporting issue, you know not to default to a “data-only” answer - you can tell whether the real problem is a system that isn't capturing the right data, a process nobody owns, or a data model that no longer matches the business
  • Ability to flex your communication style as needed - equally fluent giving execs the top-line takeaway and working through the nuances with the operational teams to drive a solution 
  • First hand experience ensuring a business’s data and reporting keep up following an acquisition or new product launch - designing and driving the solution so the business doesn’t lose visibility into itself
  • Bonus: experience inside a post-close M&A integration, a new product introduction, or a go-to-market model change
  • Bonus: experience in late-stage B2B SaaS startups (i.e., Series E+) and / or early public B2B SaaS companies (e.g., 3-5k employees)


#LI-JB1
#LI-Remote

The salary for this role is dependent on geographic location and will be based on the individual candidate's job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

In addition to base salary, for sales and some sales-adjacent roles, employees are eligible to earn incentive compensation (commission). For all other roles, employees are eligible to participate in the Cribl Corporate Bonus Program.

In addition to a competitive salary, Cribl also offers a generous benefits package which includes health, dental, vision, short-term disability, and life insurance, paid holidays and paid time off, a fertility treatment benefit, 401(k), and equity.

Base Salary Range
$190,000—$255,000 USD

Bring Your Whole Self

Diversity drives innovation, enables better decisions to support our customers, and inspires change for the better. We’re building a culture where differences are valued and welcomed, and we work together to bring out the best in each other. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.

Interested in joining the Cribl herd? Learn more about the smartest, funniest, most passionate goats you’ll ever meet at cribl.io/about-us.

item.title: Oportun: Repossession Coordinator (R14323)
item.description:
Headquarters: Remote - US

Who We Are

Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually.

The Opportunity

As part of the Collections team, the Repossession Coordinator manages key activities across Oportun’s repossession and remarketing process, supporting members with delinquent accounts while coordinating timely, accurate actions with internal partners and third-party vendors. Success in this role means maintaining strong operational controls, clear communication, accurate account and inventory reviews, and adherence to applicable lending regulations and Oportun policies.

At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in.

What You'll Do

Your day-to-day

  • You'll provide support and guidance to members with delinquent accounts who may be eligible for repossession, ensuring clear and respectful communication throughout the process.
  • You'll coordinate repossession and remarketing activities with members, internal business partners, and third-party vendors to support timely and accurate execution.
  • You'll complete required account reviews, letters, scrubs, and other operational steps associated with repossession and remarketing.
  • You'll monitor repossession and remarketing inventory and account status, identifying issues and escalating or routing them accurately to the appropriate partners.
  • You'll communicate and collaborate effectively with business partners to resolve workflow issues and keep repossession and remarketing activities moving.
  • You'll maintain current knowledge of applicable lending regulations and Oportun policies and apply them consistently in day-to-day work.

Who You Are

The right fit looks like this

  • You're detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a regulated operational environment.
  • You solve problems thoughtfully, communicate clearly with members and partners, and know when an issue needs to be escalated.
  • You're comfortable navigating complexity and don't wait for perfect information to move forward.
  • You're comfortable navigating complexity and don't wait for perfect information to move forward. You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, and expect the same in return.

What You Bring

Skills & experience

Required

  • You'll have 5–7 years of collections experience.
  • You'll have 5–7 years of repossession experience.
  • You've demonstrated strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • You communicate effectively and collaborate with members, business partners, and third-party vendors. You bring working knowledge of applicable lending regulations and the ability to follow established policies and procedures.

Nice to Have

  • Bilingual communication skills.
  • Experience supporting vehicle remarketing processes.
  • Familiarity with tools or systems used to manage collections, repossession, remarketing, or inventory workflows.
  • You've used AI tools (ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar) to improve your own productivity.

Our AI Mindset

We build with AI. We lead with judgment.

AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work.

We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting, willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle.

In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together.

Why Oportun

What's in it for you

Oportun offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and professional well-being. Benefits vary by country of employment.

Some of the benefits available to eligible employees include:

US Benefits

  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
  • 401(k) including company match
  • Flexible PTO and Parental Leave
  • Company-paid Life & Disability Insurance
  • Eligibility and plan details vary by location and employment status. To learn more about Oportun and our benefits, visit oportun.com/careers.

The US hourly range for this full-time position is $24.51 - $36.77.

Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects a national minimum and maximum range for new hire salaries for this position.

Within this range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, such as job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range that meets your criteria during the hiring process.

Please note that the compensation range listed in this posting reflects only the base salary for this position and does not include other compensation elements or benefits. #LI-REMOTE #LI-RR1

 

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment opportunities without regard to race, age, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other category protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

item.title: Workiva: Principal Experience Designer - Visual Design & Design Systems
item.description:
Headquarters: United States
URL: https://www.workiva.com/latam/

Workiva is looking for a Principal Experience Designer to shape the visual future of Unify, our enterprise design system. Unify powers the components, patterns, templates, accessibility standards, and shared experiences used across Workiva’s B2B platform.

This is a dual-focus principal role. Roughly 60–70% of your time will be spent leading Unify’s visual design direction: evolving its visual language, shaping token architecture, and creating the reference designs and guidance that help teams build consistently. The remaining 30–40% will focus on high-visibility visual work for major conferences, marketing partnerships, and executive audiences. That work is not separate from the system, it’s part of the broader ecosystem of design in which Unify lives.

You will bring exceptional visual craft, strong systems thinking, and a practical point of view on how design systems need to evolve for AI-assisted design and prototyping.

What you’ll do

  • Define and evolve Unify’s visual language across typography, color, spacing, iconography, motion, and brand expression.
  • Partner with the components sub-team and the patterns and templates sub-team to ensure visual design is applied consistently and intentionally across every asset.
  • Partner with product design, product mgmt and engineering teams to ensure product experience decisions translate faithfully from system to production.
  • Maintain a scalable, semantic token architecture that supports consistent experiences across products and over time.
  • Create and maintain a library of reference designs, full-screen examples that demonstrate how Unify should be applied in real product experiences.
  • Own visual usage guidance and documentation that make intended use, constraints, and quality standards clear for designers, engineers, and AI-assisted workflows.
  • Establish ongoing evaluation of AI-generated designs and prototypes, using what you learn to strengthen tokens, examples, and guidance before inconsistencies reach product teams.
  • Lead visual design for select high-stakes moments, including major conferences, executive presentations, product vision work, and marketing partnerships.
  • Coach designers and influence cross-functional partners through high-quality feedback, clear principles, and strong visual storytelling.

What you’ll need

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in product design, visual design, UX, or related fields, including significant work on platform or enterprise products.
  • Bachelor's degree in Design, HCI, or a related field (or 8 years of experience and a Master's degree; or a PhD with 6 years of experience).

Preferred Qualifications

  • A portfolio demonstrating exceptional visual craft and the ability to translate a visual point of view into scalable product systems.
  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted design or prototyping workflows, with a clear perspective on their opportunities and limitations.
  • Experience defining or evolving a design system’s visual language, including tokens, components, patterns, and documentation.
  • Strong ability to create compelling product narratives for senior leaders and high-visibility audiences.
  • Experience partnering closely with engineers and working through the tradeoffs between design intent, system health, and implementation.
  • A track record of influencing and coaching teams without relying on formal authority.
  • Experience building reference sites, design-system documentation, or machine-readable design guidance.
  • Experience with semantic or multi-tier token systems, motion design, presentation design, or event experiences.
  • Background in front-end development, developer tools, cross-platform systems, or highly regulated industries.

Travel Requirements & Working Conditions

  • Up to 20-25% travel required to meet with teams, partners, and customers
  • Reliable internet connection required for remote or hybrid work environments 

How You’ll Be Rewarded

✅ Salary range in the US: $190,000.00 - $315,000.00

✅ A discretionary bonus typically paid annually

✅ Restricted Stock Units granted at time of hire

✅ 401(k) match and comprehensive employee benefits package

The salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this job in the US. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience and other relevant factors.

Why Join Workiva

Workiva is the platform designed to bring confidence, control, and a competitive edge to the world’s most complex organizations. Our AI-powered platform unifies finance, risk, and sustainability on a single, secure foundation—ensuring data is trusted, traceable, and ready to act on. With an unbroken path from source to output, leaders gain confidence in their numbers, visibility into current and emerging risks, and the ability to move with speed and precision in a constantly changing world.

At Workiva, you’ll bring technology to market that executives, boards, and regulators depend on. The work you do here helps organizations navigate uncertainty, maintain trust, and make decisions that stand up to scrutiny. If you’re energized by meaningful challenges, inspired by collaborative teams, and motivated to help organizations turn uncertainty into advantage, we’d love to meet you.

 

Employment decisions are made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other protected characteristic.

item.title: Jobs for Humanity: Lead Intake / CRM Manager
item.skills: Analytics, CRM, Digital Marketing, Email Marketing and Automation, Google Analytics, Inbound Marketing, Influencer Marketing, CRM Systems, Analytics Tools, and CRM Integration
item.description:
Headquarters: Beirut, Lebanon
URL: http://jobsforhumanity.com

Company Description

AB Group PLLC is a dynamic architecture firm with a passion for delivering innovative and impactful designs. Specializing in hospitality, multifamily, and office projects, we take pride in creating spaces that inspire. We are expanding our talented team and looking for a skilled Autodesk Revit Draftsperson to join us remotely from Lebanon.

Job Description

Position Overview

ABG is seeking a highly responsive, articulate, and results-driven Appointment Setter and HubSpot CRM Manager.
This person will be responsible for contacting new inbound leads within 60 seconds of:

  • Submitting a contact form through the ABG website.
  • Calling ABG’s front desk line.
  • Leaving a voicemail or missed call.
  • Entering ABG’s lead system through another marketing channel.
  • This position requires an exceptionally high sense of urgency. Every minute of delay reduces the likelihood of connecting with and converting a prospective client.
  • The successful candidate must have impeccable spoken and written English, a confident telephone presence, strong listening skills, and the ability to communicate professionally with business owners, developers, contractors, investors, property owners, and other decision-makers.
  • The role also includes cold calling and cold emailing targeted contact lists to create new relationships and generate opportunities in specific geographic and industry markets.

Core Responsibilities

Inbound Lead Response

  • Monitor website inquiries, phone calls, voicemails, emails, and assigned lead notifications throughout working hours.
  • Call every new website lead within 60 seconds of form submission.
  • Return every missed front desk call within 60 seconds of receiving the notification.
  • Answer live calls promptly and professionally whenever assigned to front desk coverage.
  • Send an immediate follow-up email when a lead does not answer.
  • Continue following up through an organized call and email cadence until the lead:
  • Responds.
  • Schedules an appointment.
  • Requests future follow-up.
  • Is confirmed as unqualified.
  • Opts out of further communication.
  • Never allow an inbound lead to sit in HubSpot without a documented response attempt and scheduled next action.

Lead Qualification

  • Conduct an effective initial conversation to understand:
  • Prospect name, company, and contact information.
  • Project address and geographic location.
  • Project type and intended use.
  • Requested architectural, engineering, interior design, permitting, or consulting services.
  • Current project status.
  • Estimated project size and scope.
  • Target schedule.
  • Preliminary construction or design budget.
  • Property ownership or site-control status.
  • Decision-makers involved.
  • How the prospect heard about ABG.
  • Identify whether the opportunity is aligned with ABG’s services and target markets.
  • Ask clear and direct questions without making the prospect feel interrogated.
  • Avoid providing technical, legal, pricing, or code-related advice beyond the approved qualification script.
  • Escalate urgent, high-value, or strategically important opportunities immediately.
  • Appointment Setting
  • Schedule qualified prospects with the correct ABG team member.
  • Confirm the appointment date, time, meeting format, project address, and attendee information.
  • Send calendar invitations and confirmation messages immediately.
  • Send appointment reminders to improve attendance.
  • Reschedule cancelled or missed appointments quickly.
  • Ensure the assigned ABG team member has complete qualification notes before the meeting.
  • Follow up after the appointment when directed and update the opportunity status in HubSpot.

HubSpot CRM Management

  • Serve as the day-to-day owner of sales data quality in HubSpot.
  • Create and maintain accurate:
  • Contact records.
  • Company records.
  • Deal records.
  • Lead-source information.
  • Deal stages.
  • Activity records.
  • Follow-up tasks.
  • Appointment records.
  • Log every call, voicemail, email, response, qualification note, appointment, and follow-up action.
  • Ensure every open lead has:
  • A clearly assigned owner.
  • The correct pipeline stage.
  • Complete contact information.
  • A documented last activity.
  • A scheduled next action.
  • A realistic follow-up date.
  • Move deals through ABG’s sales pipeline based on verified activity:
  • First Contact.
  • Discovery.
  • Send Fee.
  • Fee Sent.
  • Standby.
  • Accepted.
  • Send Contract.
  • Contract Sent.
  • Project Won or Project Lost.
  • Prevent duplicate contacts, companies, and deals.
  • Standardize naming conventions and correct incomplete or inaccurate records.
  • Identify stale deals, overdue tasks, missing follow-ups, and opportunities without recent activity.
  • Maintain lead lists, call queues, workflows, templates, sequences, and reporting dashboards.
  • Produce daily and weekly reports covering:
  • New inbound leads.
  • Average response time.
  • Leads contacted within 60 seconds.
  • Contact rate.
  • Qualified leads.
  • Appointments scheduled.
  • Appointment attendance rate.
  • Outbound calls and emails.
  • New relationships created.
  • Pipeline-stage movement.
  • Stale or neglected opportunities.
  • CRM data-quality issues.
  • Cold Calling and Cold Emailing

Conduct structured outbound campaigns targeting ABG’s priority markets.

  • Call and email prospective:
  • Real estate developers.
  • General contractors.
  • Commercial property owners.
  • Real estate investors.
  • Brokers and tenant representatives.
  • Property managers.
  • Franchise owners and operators.
  • Restaurant and hospitality groups.
  • Retail and industrial businesses.
  • Multifamily and residential developers.
  • Strategic referral partners.
  • Research contacts and verify names, titles, companies, telephone numbers, email addresses, locations, and market relevance.
  • Use approved scripts and email templates while keeping conversations natural and personalized.
  • Introduce ABG’s capabilities clearly and confidently.
  • Focus on building relationships, identifying upcoming projects, and securing introductory meetings.
  • Handle common objections professionally and continue the conversation without becoming aggressive.
  • Document all outbound activity and prospect responses in HubSpot.
  • Create follow-up tasks for every viable prospect.
  • Maintain organized prospect lists by market, relationship type, campaign, and opportunity status.
  • Provide feedback on which industries, messages, and contact lists generate the strongest results.

Non-Negotiable Performance Standards

  • Demonstrate an exceptional sense of urgency at all times.
  • Contact new inbound leads within 60 seconds during assigned coverage hours.
  • Maintain impeccable spoken and written English.
  • Communicate clearly without grammatical errors, excessive filler words, slang, or an unprofessional tone.
  • Remain available and attentive during scheduled lead-response coverage.
  • Treat every inbound inquiry as a time-sensitive potential client.
  • Complete CRM updates immediately after each interaction.
  • Never rely on memory or personal notes in place of HubSpot documentation.
  • Never leave a lead without a clearly documented next action.
  • Follow through on commitments without repeated reminders.
  • Maintain a polished, confident, helpful, and professional demeanor.
  • Protect confidential client, project, and company information.
  • Key Performance Indicators

Percentage of inbound leads called within 60 seconds.

  • Average first-response time.
  • Inbound lead contact rate.
  • Qualified-lead rate.
  • Appointment-setting rate.
  • Appointment attendance rate.
  • Missed appointment recovery rate.
  • Number of outbound calls completed.
  • Number of personalized outbound emails sent.
  • Outbound contact and response rate.
  • Number of qualified outbound appointments scheduled.
  • Number of new strategic relationships created.
  • Percentage of CRM records with complete required information.
  • Percentage of open opportunities with a scheduled next activity.
  • Number of stale or overdue opportunities.
  • Accuracy and timeliness of daily and weekly reports.
  • Required Qualifications

Exceptional spoken and written English.

  • Clear, confident, and professional telephone voice.
  • Strong listening, questioning, and note-taking skills.
  • Demonstrated success in appointment setting, inside sales, lead qualification, business development, or customer service.
  • Experience using HubSpot CRM or a comparable CRM platform.
  • Ability to learn ABG’s services, target markets, qualification criteria, and sales process.
  • Ability to work quickly without sacrificing accuracy or professionalism.
  • Strong organizational skills and consistent attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage a high volume of calls, emails, tasks, and records.
  • Comfortable speaking with senior decision-makers and business owners.
  • Ability to handle rejection and objections without losing momentum.
  • Reliable internet, telephone access, and a professional work environment if working remotely.

 

    Qualifications

    Preferred Qualifications

    • Experience managing HubSpot contacts, companies, deals, tasks, lists, workflows, sequences, and reports.
    • Experience in architecture, engineering, construction, commercial real estate, professional services, or a related industry.
    • Experience with business-to-business cold calling and email outreach.
    • Familiarity with calendar scheduling, email platforms, contact databases, and list-building tools.
    • Experience qualifying projects involving architecture, engineering, permitting, construction, development, or property improvements.

    Personal Characteristics

    • Urgent and highly responsive.
    • Persistent without being pushy.
    • Organized and process-oriented.
    • Competitive and motivated by measurable results.
    • Comfortable being held accountable to activity and conversion targets.
    • Professional under pressure.
    • Coachable and receptive to call reviews and feedback.
    • Proactive in identifying problems and recommending improvements.
    • Consistent, dependable, and disciplined.
    • Focused on creating an excellent first impression of ABG.

    What Success Looks Like

    • Prospective clients are contacted while their interest is at its highest.
    • Every lead receives fast, professional, and persistent follow-up.
    • Qualified prospects are consistently converted into scheduled appointments.
    • ABG’s HubSpot pipeline is accurate, current, and easy for leadership to manage.
    • No viable opportunity is lost because of slow response, poor communication, or missing follow-up.
    • Outbound campaigns create measurable new relationships and qualified opportunities in ABG’s target markets.
    • ABG’s leadership receives reliable reporting and has complete visibility into every active prospect and next action.

    Candidate Evaluation

    • A mock inbound lead-response call.
    • A cold-call role-play.

    Additional Information

Scale our distribution by code: a fleet of real devices, iPhones first and Android too, plus platform APIs and AI agents, posting across many accounts and surfaces. You work directly with the founder.

 

Most content gets made and then dies at a few hundred views, because getting it out is still done by hand: a person, a phone, a few accounts. We want it engineered: iPhone and Android device automation at scale, platform APIs and agents posting across many accounts and surfaces, every link tracked. If you would rather build that fleet than tap through posts one at a time, read on.

 

Vertex Marketing Group builds AI creators and makes the content for real ones. Your job is to get that content out at a volume no team could post by hand, and keep the machine running. You own the outcome.

 

What you'll do

• Build and run the device fleet that posts by code: iPhones first, Android too, real devices and cloud phones

• Publish across Instagram, TikTok, X, Reddit and Threads through platform APIs plus device and browser automation, hundreds of posts a day

• Automate account health and posting cadence: every account checked every morning by code, problems caught before they cost reach

• Put agents to work on the pipeline: Claude Code and MCPs handling captions, scheduling, health checks and recovery

Requirements

• You have built and run posting automation across 100+ accounts, and you can show it running

• You have automated iPhones or other iOS devices (and/or Android, cloud phones) that run unattended

• You work with platform APIs plus browser and mobile automation, with queues and scheduling

Big plus: a development, infrastructure or DevOps background, and growth analytics: you read the numbers and know what to post more of.

 

Compensation

$4,000 to $6,000 per month, full-time, remote. Where you land in the range depends on what you show us. Same rate from day one of the paid test. Reviewed after 6 months.

 

Why Vertex?

• You own the outcome: your fleet, your numbers, your call on what goes out where

• You work directly with the founder, in a small team of sharp people who are fun to work with
