item.description:
Headquarters: Ghent - Belgium
URL: https://www.twikey.com/jobs

Are you a driven back-end developer who doesn't wait for instructions, but is already thinking two steps ahead? Who experiments with new technologies and smart solutions alongside the job? Then we want to talk to you.

Straight forward but clear: Twikey isn't looking for someone to just execute. We're looking for someone who thinks, does and keeps going when the going gets tough.

Because fintech is evolving at breakneck speed. That calls for real ownership and for someone who can dive deep on the technical side to keep innovating and improving our platform. You get plenty in return, such as the freedom and responsibility to deliver your own projects. Thanks in part to our organisational structure, you can shape your ideas in the short term and see the results of your hard work quickly.

Driven by your passion for building scalable, performant and secure back-end systems, you continuously raise the bar for your own skills and for our product.

As a member of our development team you work closely with our CTO, 3 fellow developers and 2 testers on the core of our software application. A small, strong team in which you take on a role with real impact on the future of our product.

  • You focus on developing and improving the back-end of our platform, optimising the architecture and data processing while keeping the security and stability of our system in mind. This lets you put your technical skills to full use and come up with innovative solutions.
  • With your expertise you'll make valuable suggestions and streamline processes for all our stakeholders, so we can work more efficiently and achieve better results.
  • You provide technical support on integration projects with software houses, banks and large companies, solving complex technical problems. That gives you the chance to work on challenging projects and to get in touch with a wide range of technologies and industries.

Once you know our product inside out, there are plenty of challenging projects for you to help build.

What are we looking for in you?

  • You are driven, curious and enterprising. Not only in your job, but outside of it too. You have a pro-active attitude and are always a few steps ahead: you spot opportunities, grab them and get to work.
  • Technical challenges? You take them on, not because you have to, but because you want to learn. You're a self-starter and quickly get to grips with new technologies, languages or frameworks.
  • You understand that a good product is never "finished". You draw energy from that mix of creating and fine-tuning. You think along, question things and keep building new solutions.
  • You have experience using AI tools to build integrations. You're actively exploring how AI can contribute to smarter user experiences and more efficient software development. Experience with data analytics is an asset.
  • You therefore attach a lot of importance to the security, stability and reliability of a system and know what it takes to get there. You work in a structured, meticulous way and write code that is clean, reusable and easy to test.
  • You have demonstrable experience with Java, Go and the Spring framework. Experience with API integrations, web services, Linux or other relevant areas is a plus.
  • You have a deep understanding of databases. You don't just know how to use them, you know how they work. You have an opinion on structured, high-quality code, architecture and back-end technologies.
  • You have a very good command of English, for smooth collaboration with all colleagues and stakeholders. Dutch is an asset.
  • You are based in a time zone within one hour of CET, so your working day overlaps with the team's for the daily stand-ups and close day-to-day collaboration.
  • You can work independently and enjoy a small team where switching gears quickly, collaboration and knowledge sharing are central.

Twikey offers you:

  • An environment where challenge, innovation and autonomy come first.
  • The room to experiment, to challenge and to improve. And we expect you to really take that room.
  • An ideal setting if you want to grow fast and healthily, both technically and personally. Training, ownership, taking on new or additional roles based on your talents and interests, ... a lot is possible here, and you're at the wheel!
  • A complementary team of more than 35 colleagues who move forward together in a respectful and open atmosphere.
  • A motivating workplace with plenty of knowledge and expertise, shared both formally during the daily stand-ups and the weekly Friday call, and informally at the coffee machine.
  • Appreciation, openness and critical dialogue. Our Friction Hunter Trophy is an example: every month we celebrate the colleague who made the biggest difference for customers, teammates or internally. Your impact gets noticed!
  • A modern workplace with different zones (conference, connect, co-work, concentrate) in a recently built, industrial-style office building. Easy to reach by car, by bike and by public transport on the edge of Ghent, right next to the KBC tower.
  • A salary package tailored to your experience and skills, with plenty of extra-legal benefits, a collective bonus system and a cafeteria plan to convert your 13th month as you choose.
  • The chance to work in an innovative Belgian fintech scale-up that is active in several countries, in a sector that is growing fast!

A job ad doesn't tell you everything. Our colleagues tell you here what it's really like to work at Twikey.

item.description:
Headquarters: US
URL: https://openbase.ai/

Head of Growth & Operations — Openbase.ai

Full-time | Remote | Reports directly to the Founder

About Openbase

Openbase.ai is an AI gateway that helps developers and businesses access multiple AI models through one API. We simplify model access, routing, and usage management so teams can focus on building AI products.

Our MVP is ready. We are hiring a hands-on leader to own our go-to-market strategy, day-to-day business execution, and journey from launch to our first 10,000 users.

The opportunity

You will work directly with the founder to turn Openbase into a growing business with repeatable customer acquisition, strong retention, and disciplined operations.

You will own the commercial execution: finding our first customers, testing acquisition channels, improving onboarding, building partnerships, and organizing the people and systems needed to grow.

Our ambition is 10,000 users. Your responsibility is to build a credible, measurable path toward that goal, with clear milestones for activated developers, retained customers, paying accounts, and profitable usage.

What you will own

1. Go-to-market and customer acquisition

  • Identify our strongest initial customer segments, including AI startups, independent developers, agencies, and software teams.
  • Develop our positioning and explain why developers should choose Openbase.
  • Launch and improve acquisition across X, SEO, visibility in AI search engines, developer communities, partnerships, and targeted outbound.
  • Test paid campaigns with clear budgets, conversion tracking, and criteria for scaling or stopping.
  • Build a growth roadmap with weekly experiments and monthly acquisition targets.

2. Developer activation and retention

  • Own the journey from website visit to signup, first successful API request, first payment, and ongoing usage.
  • Work with engineering to remove onboarding friction and improve documentation, quickstarts, and integration examples.
  • Speak directly with developers to understand why they try Openbase, keep using it, or leave.
  • Establish onboarding communications, customer support processes, and reactivation campaigns.
  • Turn successful customer implementations into case studies and referrals.

3. Sales and partnerships

  • Personally source and close early customers.
  • Build a qualified pipeline of startups and businesses with recurring AI usage.
  • Develop distribution partnerships with developer tools, AI communities, accelerators, and complementary platforms.
  • Coordinate technical evaluations and customer requirements with engineering.
  • Build a repeatable sales process as demand grows.

4. Business execution and team management

  • Translate company goals into weekly priorities, accountable owners, and delivery dates.
  • Recruit and manage freelancers, agencies, and future hires across growth, content, developer relations, and customer success.
  • Own marketing budget allocation and evaluate spending against business results.
  • Coordinate customer needs with product and engineering priorities.
  • Implement practical workflows and automation that reduce manual work.

5. Metrics and commercial performance

  • Maintain a dashboard covering acquisition, activation, retention, paying customers, and API usage.
  • Track customer acquisition cost, conversion rates, and retention by channel.
  • Separate customer spending from provider costs and Openbase’s retained revenue and gross profit.
  • Monitor promotional credits and infrastructure costs so growth remains economically sound.
  • Give the founder a clear weekly view of results, blockers, and decisions needed.

What we are looking for

  • Experience leading growth and commercial execution at an early-stage SaaS, API, developer-tools, or AI infrastructure company.
  • Evidence of acquiring users from an early starting point, with specific numbers and your personal contribution.
  • Understanding of developer audiences and how technical products earn adoption.
  • Ability to understand an API integration, follow documentation, and discuss onboarding issues with engineers.
  • Hands-on ability to run experiments, analyze funnels, conduct customer calls, and manage delivery.
  • Experience managing budgets and external specialists.
  • Strong written English, sound judgment, and comfort working directly with a founder.

Experience with usage-based pricing, developer relations, technical SEO, and AI model platforms is particularly relevant.

Why join

  • Direct ownership of Openbase’s launch and growth.
  • Close collaboration with the founder and engineering team.
  • The opportunity to build the commercial function from its earliest stage.
  • Scope to take on broader company leadership as the business grows.

How to apply

Send your CV or LinkedIn profile, together with brief answers to:

  1. Which product have you helped grow? Include starting users, ending users, timeframe, budget, and your exact role.
  2. Which acquisition channels produced retained or paying customers?
  3. How would you approach Openbase’s first 1,000 activated developers?
  4. What would you personally execute, and where would you use specialists?
  5. What are your location, availability, and compensation expectations?

Include an example of a growth experiment or operating system you built. Share only information you are authorized to disclose.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/openbase-llc-head-of-growth-operations

item.description:
Headquarters: United States
URL: https://icarusdigitalmarketing.com/

Performance Creative Strategist and AI Producer

Remote | Full time | Paid 30-day working trial

Icarus Digital Marketing builds and scales direct-response ecommerce brands, including brands in difficult and restricted categories. We are hiring a hands-on performance creative operator to work directly with the owners on our internal portfolio of brands.

This is not a conventional graphic-design role. We need someone who understands why Meta ads convert and can personally turn that understanding into high-quality static and video creative using current AI production tools.

You may come from dropshipping, affiliate marketing, DTC, a performance agency, or a creative media-buying background. We care more about commercial judgment, production ability, speed, and proof of work than polished credentials.

The work

You will use and help improve our internal Creative Cockpit. It takes a brand from research and foundational strategy through campaign creation, production, review, and delivery. For each brand, the system holds brand assets and voice, customer language and audience psychology, pains and desires, necessary beliefs, competitor intelligence, awareness levels, angles, hooks, offer context, prior creative, winners, and performance signals.

Your job is to turn that intelligence into creative that can sell.

  • Read campaign briefs, audience research, voice-of-customer material, and brand strategy documents.
  • Decide what each batch should test and why.
  • Source and analyse strong visual and structural references.
  • Develop angles, hooks, scripts, concepts, storyboards, and landing-page direction.
  • Personally produce static ads and short-form video ads.
  • Use AI image, video, voice, and editing tools at a high level.
  • Create meaningful variants without producing repetitive AI slop.
  • Review work for persuasion, visual quality, brand fit, platform fit, and compliance.
  • Refine weak generations rather than accepting the first output.
  • Package approved assets for launch and document what each concept tests.
  • Read results and use the learning to plan the next batch.

What you must be good at

  • Direct-response advertising and Meta creative strategy
  • Audience psychology and voice-of-customer interpretation
  • Awareness levels, hooks, angles, mechanisms, objections, offers, and message-market fit
  • Understanding when an ad should lead to a PDP, advertorial, listicle, quiz, or sales page
  • Static ad, UGC, and short-form video production
  • Visual-reference analysis and controlled recreation
  • Current AI image and video workflows using tools such as Seedance, Google Flow/Omni, Nano Banana/Gemini, GPT Image, Higgsfield, Kling, Sora, Veo, or comparable tools
  • Editing, compositing, pacing, captions, sound, and final polish
  • Fast, organised batch production
  • Reading creative performance and choosing the next test

You are probably not right for this role if

  • Your portfolio is mostly branding, organic social content, or attractive design without performance context.
  • You call every asset “scroll-stopping” but cannot explain the audience belief or conversion mechanism.
  • You are a strategist who depends on other people to make the work.
  • You are a tool operator who needs someone else to provide every hook, angle, script, and decision.
  • You use one prompt, accept the first output, and call it AI production.
  • You cannot show exactly what you personally contributed to portfolio examples.
  • You dislike volume, iteration, testing, or direct feedback.

What success looks like

Within 30 days, you can understand our strategy packs and operating system, take a structured brief from research to finished assets with limited supervision, produce a useful weekly mix of static and video concepts, explain the reason for every important decision, maintain quality while moving quickly, and suggest practical improvements to the workflow.

Compensation

The role begins with a fully paid 30-day working trial at USD $2,000. If the fit is strong, it becomes a long-term full-time position expected to pay USD $2,000 to $3,000 per month, based on demonstrated level, with additional performance upside available for an exceptional long-term operator.

We care about ability, English comprehension, reliability, some overlap with our working hours, and quality of output.

How to apply

Do not send a generic cover letter. Message Simon on WhatsApp at +353 86 349 5073 and begin with: I make the work.

  1. Send three Meta ads you personally made or materially directed.
  2. For each example, state exactly what you did and explain the audience, angle, hook, and intended next step in the funnel.
  3. Share any useful performance context you are permitted to disclose. Redacted evidence is acceptable.
  4. Show one weak or failed creative and explain what you learned or changed.
  5. List the AI tools you use in real production and explain your normal workflow from reference to finished asset.
  6. Send a Loom of no more than five minutes. Choose one Meta ad you respect, explain why it works, and describe the next three variants you would test.
  7. State your location, timezone, availability, and expected monthly compensation after the trial.

Applications without the requested evidence will not be reviewed. Shortlisted candidates will complete a small paid practical exercise before the 30-day trial.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/icarus-digital-marketing-performance-creative-strategist-and-ai-producer

item.title: New Law Business Model: Solutions Engineer - Customer Success
item.skills: Engineer and Client Relationship Management
item.description:
Headquarters: Boulder, CO
URL: https://newlawbusinessmodel.com

For over 10 years, New Law Business Model (NLBM) has been on a mission to liberate lawyers from outdated, soul-crushing practice models. We provide the heart-centered framework—Life & Legacy Planning®—and the high-octane membership products required to build thriving, relational firms. With a community of 800+ Personal Family Lawyer® firms nationwide, we leverage elite AI and automation to amplify humanity, delivering the practical education, tools, and "done-for-you" systems lawyers need to reclaim their time and build a lasting legacy. We obsess over real-world outcomes, not just vibes, to ensure our members move from survival mode to true flourishing.

The Mission

This Solutions Engineer role independently troubleshoots, maintains, and improves the technology and systems that power Accelerator. You’ll investigate complex technical problems, determine root causes, test and implement solutions, document the work, explain technical concepts clearly, and help create repeatable solutions that reduce recurring issues over time.

 

You are a systems navigator, technical troubleshooter, educator, and client advocate who gets the details right while meeting overwhelmed users with patience and clarity.

 

This role requires ownership, curiosity, patience, and a genuine desire to help people succeed—not simply close tickets.

Job requirements

What You’ll Do

Pillar 1: Member Support, Troubleshooting & Education

  • Own complex technical troubleshooting from discovery through resolution, including root-cause analysis, testing, implementation, documentation, and follow-through.

  • Meet members where they are technically, turning complex issues into clear, approachable guidance through Loom, email, phone, or whatever channel works best.

  • Help members understand not just what to do, but why it matters, so they feel confident handling similar situations in the future; coordinate with external partners and maintain full accountability through resolution. 

Pillar 2: Accelerator Platform & Systems Operations

  • Administer and support the Accelerator technology environment across GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Asana, and connected systems, including the relationships between HubSpot firms, orders, contracts, Asana implementation projects, and Accelerator member accounts.

  • Complete approved account builds, updates, pauses, reactivations, migrations, and technical closeout tasks while troubleshooting workflows, pipelines, calendars, forms, permissions, and settings.

  • Investigate deliverability, phone/SMS, domains, DNS, integrations, and data issues; maintain accurate records and provide bounded support for related legacy platforms as assigned.

Pillar 3: Quality Assurance, Integrations & AI-Assisted Work

  • Use AI thoughtfully and approved integration tools to investigate issues, interpret errors, and complete member requests.

  • Verify recommendations and changes against actual system settings, reliable documentation, and realistic test scenarios.

  • Investigate APIs, webhooks, authentication, logs, and field mappings; coordinate complex development needs, document results and limitations, and protect confidential member information.

Pillar 4: Documentation, Knowledge Sharing & Improvement

  • Learn, document, and progressively take ownership of recurring technical processes.

  • Document technical knowledge so teammates can work confidently and apply repeatable solutions.

  • Identify patterns across recurring technical issues and recommend repeatable fixes, documentation, automation, or product improvements.

     

What Success Looks Like

  • Members receive accurate solutions, timely updates, clear next steps, and greater confidence using the technology that supports their firms.

  • Technical requests are handled with strong ownership and reliable follow-through, while changes are tested, reviewed, documented, and implemented thoughtfully.

  • Recurring issues lead to better instructions, reusable solutions, or system improvements that teammates can access and apply confidently; you identify problems early and help move members from frustration to forward momentum.

     

Who You Are

  • You have hands-on experience administering and troubleshooting GoHighLevel and HubSpot across multiple accounts, including workflows, order forms, contracts, client records, and support tickets.

  • You understand workflows, pipelines, snapshots, calendars, forms, permissions, account configuration, and the dependencies between shared systems and firm-specific customizations.

  • You are a patient, compassionate teacher who explains technical concepts in plain language and can guide clients through solutions over Loom or Zoom.

  • You understand APIs, webhooks, authentication, JSON, logs, data mapping, email, phone/SMS, DNS, and calendar integrations; you use AI responsibly, document as you go, share knowledge, and own follow-through.

Helpful additional experience includes law-firm or professional-services operations, estate planning, Keap, Lawmatics, Make, Zapier, n8n, data migrations, reconciliation, or light JavaScript, TypeScript, or Python.
